name: Roy C.
subject: Before I log off for the day
body:
I wanted to let you know where things stand.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk841&source=&t=1&akid=2323%2E124072%2EeN-jIy)
| | | |
---
Hi Peter, I’m about to log off for the day, but I wanted to let you know where things stand with our new ad.
Ever since I reached out yesterday asking for your help to keep this ad on the air, my campaign has received a surge of grassroots support from people like you. I’m so grateful.
Right now, the GOP is relentless in its attacks against me – whether it’s President Trump and Stephen Miller lying about me online and on Fox News, or dark-money super PACs putting nearly $100 million (so far) behind baseless ads smearing my name.
This Senate race is going to be a fight to the finish, and whether we have the resources to compete – and to reach North Carolina voters with ads of our own – depends on _you_. **We’re just shy of what we’d hoped to raise by the end of the day today, so I’m turning to you for help.**
[**_If you believe in my campaign and understand how important it is that we reach voters with our message before the GOP does, will you chip in $5 to make sure our new ad stays live? It’s going to take all of us to flip this critical seat, so I’m hoping I can count on your support today._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17143?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk841&amount=5&t=8&akid=2323%2E124072%2EeN-jIy)

Roy Cooper

Peter - It’s Zoe with an important message.

Tomorrow, we hit the 100-day mark to Election Day.

That's it. That's how much time we have to flip three House seats blue and stop Republicans from cementing control.

FLIP THE HOUSE BLUE

When I voted yes on Prop 50, I knew that it could be our golden ticket to taking back the House despite Trump’s best efforts to weaponize redistricting against us.

It united Democrats. It energized voters. It proved we could win and resist Trump’s authoritarian agenda.

But I’ll be frank: we’re in the fight for our lives. Republicans are pouring hundreds of millions into this upcoming election. We need resources from grassroots donors like you to compete.

While they have mega-donors and dark money, we have the people.

So it’s up to every good Democrat to step up and capitalize on the momentum Prop 50 gave us - and all it takes is $25 to make a difference.

Will you chip in $25 today to flip the House blue and protect our democracy? >>

| A Yiddish term that means guts or courage.

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2714%2E259176%2EUSHy_T) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2714%2E259176%2EUSHy_T)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14404?t=10?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.07.25_Luria-Split-Chutzpah_B4_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_RS2&amount=25&akid=2714%2E259176%2EUSHy_T) Peter, it’s Elaine Luria, Blue Amp Action said I could reach out. _Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._ In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama. That took some serious _chutzpah._ My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind. That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community. That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed. In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms. In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them. In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous. In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened. In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them. The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.** Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.** Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need. body:
The US Senate race in Nebraska is now headed toward a head to head showdown against Pete Ricketts—and MAGA is sweating it.
| | | | | [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RG2_5t4MQxbKGjJ41K7GoCHd6APZsM1yfLt5yGuvhdLGwacyULAvxEKfWxEuNLrVUnKlu8yXpvj0mdmkCe1vYgVYHrRIdxPYBsEu3DDlWTjmIoFdMOXsmxAooAfvZujZgQ_ZPQ_8jPBcaWrW6UIBeuwSn5QBgsNYLtyNs04cfk6wUerJJUp7jLnS9K3CLpE_K2N6kH1kGM4MVdQuFr91bz-rQeF6rBo1&c=Xy0gY2im_JQU55D2kFM_pK-qDtfJCugxuvfoS5DI1JBg13RE1gY3jw==&ch=6UEV85XSY_Vz6Y5vRapjofIb-BfiPyocYjy89Gd0uWHt1PP0Ez9DgA==)
---
Peter,
Nebraska has moved one step closer to being the tipping point state that could flip control of the US Senate away from Republicans.
Democrat Cindy Burbank formally filed to have her name removed from the November ballot, citing internal data that she says shows she cannot win against billionaire Republican incumbent Senator Pete Ricketts.
Burbank has previously said that the person best positioned to win in November should "have a fair shot against Ricketts." Her withdrawal from the race is consistent with her commitment to defeating Ricketts and flipping this seat.
---
| [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RG2_5t4MQxbKGjJ41K7GoCHd6APZsM1yfLt5yGuvhdLGwacyULAvxEKfWxEuNLrVUnKlu8yXpvj0mdmkCe1vYgVYHrRIdxPYBsEu3DDlWTjmIoFdMOXsmxAooAfvZujZgQ_ZPQ_8jPBcaWrW6UIBeuwSn5QBgsNYLtyNs04cfk6wUerJJUp7jLnS9K3CLpE_K2N6kH1kGM5ymZXr1NjR9ChZPbnaRijQ&c=Xy0gY2im_JQU55D2kFM_pK-qDtfJCugxuvfoS5DI1JBg13RE1gY3jw==&ch=6UEV85XSY_Vz6Y5vRapjofIb-BfiPyocYjy89Gd0uWHt1PP0Ez9DgA==)
---
At first, the Republican Secretary of State Bob Evnen hinted that he might simply refuse to accept Burbank's properly filed paperwork withdrawing her name from the ballot. Evnen told the press that he would consult with the state Attorney General, also a Republican, to decide Burbank's fate.
This move came after a prolonged legal effort by Evnen to keep Burbank off the ballot in the first place, arguing that she was a "proxy" for independent Dan Osborn.

clean_body: The US Senate race in Nebraska is now headed toward a head to head showdown against Pete Ricketts—and MAGA is sweating it. | | | | | == Peter, Nebraska has moved one step closer to being the tipping point state that could flip control of the US Senate away from Republicans. Democrat Cindy Burbank formally filed to have her name removed from the November ballot, citing internal data that she says shows she cannot win against billionaire Republican incumbent Senator Pete Ricketts. Burbank has previously said that the person best positioned to win in November should "have a fair shot against Ricketts." Her withdrawal from the race is consistent with her commitment to defeating Ricketts and flipping this seat. | == At first, the Republican Secretary of State Bob Evnen hinted that he might simply refuse to accept Burbank's properly filed paperwork withdrawing her name from the ballot. Evnen told the press that he would consult with the state Attorney General, also a Republican, to decide Burbank's fate. This move came after a prolonged legal effort by Evnen to keep Burbank off the ballot in the first place, arguing that she was a "proxy" for independent Dan Osborn. However, Evnen's cynical gambit failed and he has now admitted there is no legal basis for keeping Burbank on the ballot against her will. The US Senate race in Nebraska is now headed toward a fair fight against Pete Ricketts--and MAGA is sweating it. | Who is Leonard Leo?
He has never appeared on a ballot. He does not seek the spotlight. He is the Chairman of the Federalist Society and operates in the shadows. And from those shadows he has done incomprehensible damage to American democracy.
Leonard Leo built the Supreme Court's extremist conservative majority. He placed Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Barrett on the court. And when Trump gets to replace two or three of the oldest justices, which he is already preparing to do, Leonard Leo will choose their replacements.
Here is what Leo's court has already delivered: Roe overturned. Trump granted criminal immunity. Citizens United enabled. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Federal regulatory power dismantled. That is not a full list. It is barely the beginning. Leonard Leo is the reason you are angry. He’s the reason for our polarized politics, the corruption with no accountability, the rights that have been stripped away, the dysfunction that feels permanent. He did not cause all of it. But he built the judicial infrastructure that made all of it possible, and that is making all of it permanent.

| And then he came for the states.
Leo spent a decade doing to state Supreme Courts exactly what he did to SCOTUS, because state courts decide voting rights, reproductive freedom, and the maps that determine who controls Congress. We were watching. We beat his machine in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin. Both times he came with his network and his money. Both times we beat him.
The state court firewall is essential. But it is not enough while Leo's Supreme Court keeps changing the rules. The only permanent answer is to unpack the court he built, and the Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices seven times. No amendment required.
Leo has a thirty year head start, billions in dark money cash, and a Supreme Court that has already chosen his side. But we have hundreds of thousands of Democrats who have pitched in to defeat him twice. We like our odds. But we need you with us for what comes next: the Kansas ballot initiative, November Supreme Court elections, the 2026 midterms, and the sustained campaign to reform the court that made all of this possible. **Good Morning!** On this day in 1775, the Second Continental Congress established [the U.S. postal system](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFurDAQheGngc7INmDjwsVt6Pa2KZFjD-tJDF4xk0W8fbRR3iD1J50j_W-35Raw4H7_HzbwvNZlh5MKMMOx0Iacqe4Y9jVEjhniJySMddFSGyGt0GZJAcu1DG3yK4CGvgWv7DRKI0fr2uz16nRQKg4AMSWl02R6SGscp6hcdLFF_1qTVhslpetdl0brTAqj6aNValLNICEh16P7qLhzhrVc9QlHF-vWFp-ZH9T0_xo9N3o-z7PLSFyP6-WNnjkjiRQugbv4lUbPX4LEoxKHIugihk0AcXgvSBlSe_j0OLEUJGObQd63gOXnjv_U6On1dwAAAP__UAB9Pg), naming Benjamin Franklin as the first postmaster general. For decades, you couldn't go far without bumping into the latest issue of _Reader's Digest_ , which once boasted more than 17 million U.S. subscribers. The pocket-size magazine is still around, but on a much smaller scale, as we see in today's edition of [Whatever Happened To...](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DEP2yAUBOBfgzdbgG0wA0OrylPToUtHi8CzeQ2GyLzEyr-v0i7Zu3863d2vy3JxmDBvP9wOltayZDhrAiI4lrojxVoyurw6Tz6Cv0FAXxbJpWq5bqVagsP0WoYm2BVAQt-AFXoaueKjNk20SvEgFAwKAh-4Gp3wJqirvwYl-34QDdp3GtdSCc5Nb7owaqOCG1XvtRCTYAOHgFSO7nfBTBHW9CpPODpf9ibZSHSvrP_C5MzkfJ5nV3Ev2eVQfXxU-geZnK-l3CqT83f32CLB0VKE9itUai_vVZiByfknuABHbb_hBpU-9QcyeuKTGbU2WpvmsOF-YkpYlWYD33aH6W83-q9Dn1b-CQAA__9y_4l-) In case you missed it, this week on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla tackled the weather pattern that could rewrite the entire winter. Forecasters now put the odds at 81% that El Niño reaches "very strong" status by winter, potentially one of the largest on record, and every corner of the country will be affected. When a pattern this powerful takes over, it doesn't just tweak the forecast, it decides which states get soaked and which dry out. Ayla broke down the five ways forecasters say this El Niño will shape the months ahead. So which side of the split does your state land on? [Tune in here!](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzzFOwzAUANDTOFujH__GjgcPiCoMqJUQA2KKXPunMTh2lfy2yu0RXIELPOl9HIejiynmy8nNZHksQ6bHmoiZlmGdI09rydHl0Xn2E_lvCtGXQYJUO9A7qYbgYtqGfRXsSCQJK7KN7lpQ0GpTTVahDMacWxxdB8GD8qpDD9606AyMvor2VwMtVQNg0NSh1UYF1yr0umm6RuyBQuSy1F8lZp5oTFu501L7MlfJTszXVeCTkL2Q_VZufKvPJGSfP6U5HV6f31_eBPYs8ICI1WLD9RFTiqvSYg-X2cX0J_G_-ncrfwIAAP__O5trzA) Today's sponsor, [Blood Sugar Secrets](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOqzAQgOHTQBdkG_DgwsVr0uW1W6KJPYbZGBzhUSJuv8peYftfX_F_3eYbcuZ9-Y8beUll3uldM4nQMdeNZa1lZ9wTBgkrhQdFDmU2ytiLgouxc0TO5zy00SciQ31LXsM0KqtGcO3qgxuUnnDS2DsV-gQjmJRwBB1cVHBv2X80BcZqpVzvujiCsxFH2wfQetLNoCiylKP7LrzLSimf5UVHF8rWZr-KPGvT_2vMtTFXOTA8OlwoU633Es96VqHt0zbmWuXAPYKxKZ_t4ePzzTlztdAMatmQ868pfxrx8uYnAAD__7LOcjk), is highlighting research on an inexpensive breakfast drink that may help support stem cell activity and overall wellness, with more details available through their presentation.

**Whatever happened to _Reader's Digest_?** For decades, _Reader's Digest_ was everywhere. On your grandparents' coffee table. In every doctor's waiting room. Tucked into a purse or a back pocket, because the little magazine was designed to fit. At its peak in the 1970s, it reached more than 17 million U.S. subscribers and tens of millions more worldwide, making it the most widely read magazine on Earth. DeWitt Wallace dreamed up the idea while recovering from shrapnel wounds in World War I: to condense the best magazine articles into one pocket-sized digest. [He and his wife, Lila Bell Acheson,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSozAQAF8jMigxgASBgkvIfOmF1FgarLkTkgvNmfLvt7xf2A90V_ef23ZDTpwfv_EgJ3vZMl01kQidWz1YYi2ZMe_oxUfy_yiwLxtoMK22LZgtIKf3NjbB7URAQ0Out_OkjZ7s0kQ3BBzgToMd9eynGcIYQO9hBoNTD_u9YfehaQum13oZli5MdjEBJzN42_dzr0ZNgaWc3d_CWSLt6V1edHa-HE1yUeRZ1fBLwapglUj5Lef_Kl05HwrWT4-CNXHCFn2kWnKLObSBLhZpL0wJPSlYm9OF58UpcTVWjfpxIKdvh_xozMvBVwAAAP__9rx3qA) pictured at the link, self-published the first issue in February 1922 from a basement beneath a Greenwich Village speakeasy, mailing circulars on their wedding day to drum up charter subscriptions at $3 each. It worked. By the 1950s, _Reader's Digest_ was a cultural institution, and not just for the articles. Millions of Americans grew up flipping to _[Laughter the Best Medicine,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DEP2yAUBOBfgzdbgG0wA0OrylPToUtHi8CzeQ2GyLzEyr-v0i7Zu3863d2vy3JxmDBvP9wOltayZDhrAiI4lrojxVoyurw6Tz6Cv0FAXxbJpWq5bqVagsP0WoYm2BVAQt-AFXoaueKjNk20SvEgFAwKAh-4Gp3wJqirvwYl-34QDdp3GtdSCc5Nb7owaqOCG1XvtRCTYAOHgFSO7nfBTBHW9CpPODpf9ibZSHSvrP_C5MzkfJ5nV3Ev2eVQfXxU-geZnK-l3CqT83f32CLB0VKE9itUai_vVZiByfknuABHbb_hBpU-9QcyeuKTGbU2WpvmsOF-YkpYlWYD33aH6W83-q9Dn1b-CQAA__9y_4l-)_ swapping jokes from _Life in These United States_ and [_Humor in Uniform_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uhDAUBODTmG7R8_MfFC7S0G3alMjYj8VZgxF2Fu3tI3KFtJ9GM9J83ce7iyluj0-3kq1zHjc6S6Ja6RjLGutS8hbdNjtf_UL-SSH6PCKgvoG5oR6Di-k9yibYmQhJNGS56RRoUKZvFqsmaVAA590EnVFqmmRQXIugjZkQeBPt1QYGNQfoRd8GZXodnNLCG847ziRQiDUf7XeOW11oTu_8oqP1eW2SXWrdCxMfDAeGw3me7ew8TTk_rwDD4XHkn70wHKbD1TLHdOGeS72MA9dCSWkESIkoDcOhOWzYz5hSLNowCY_VxfS3Vv910cvibwAAAP__Txp2wA), and testing themselves with the monthly _Word Power_ vocabulary quiz. The _Reader 's Digest_ Condensed Books series, launched in 1950, became a living-room staple of its own, delivering abridged bestsellers by direct mail for nearly five decades before being renamed Select Editions in 1997. You can still [buy original sets on eBay](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykk89zmzgUx_8a-WaP9CQkdODgBHs22SSz9ma3bS6MEDKICERBgbh_fQfodNoeeqkOmvfz-z5vRvrwmD0q62xbPqnGJOHis9ZMgzMhmD4bGhuqwbdWtRelg66MfjWF1T4DDHyLxRZ4VijrrhnbFMnFGDB0YxIi4ghzHAm5qRKIhL5EhgoGLC8EAUVjJrG5aF3kMWUbm8xqWAAnGEsqd0UkJC9UxKkWhMQEMWwKG3y_q71tQ2Uu7upH0--0bzYuqULoBkT3CI4IjtM07UyurnMSwdGG-aacU8wjYBBzRI-6ahFNuwEBH1WPaMopJ5hHggEBBLz1_ayPaEoQ8ObVjOG73dsC0VQQsiVEkBi2VIDEW7wk9ZKExR5Wh-C5zwbTLO6Pk7KfsIAH1ZcmrBIswsAkSC5khIAXZrTaIJrqRTtcu9npnELAS-9LZ5zXiKYSQxzLWazzFtEUAdeq6ZQt21WXAGGURDRetyl7_9atnHFMYgaME6AIeO8GtfKsc7a_Eqlc3819kmERwTyxMb2uVLsuwOdCYDOeKrLBv_ULPvkW-A1UmfdqCeP9fNLslFbZuf58wNrXz_LL0__NC4HncD3fz9XaLcW3Nf779lRPkuXPN1V62p_vhv0THUf8ngd78y8G4qrjocodebz_rx5PcCJ3tPkkzx8Pf6WmNhd4_-fhfP8ujicyaLV_q14O-4cpm_TNpk-KbrLO2YELxHDZKOuWxxf-6MeMCXwNAAD__ydKDgY). But the digital age hit hard, and a debt-laden 2007 leveraged buyout made things worse. The company filed for bankruptcy in 2009 and again in 2013. Today, the U.S. print edition still publishes about six times a year with a circulation of around 1.6 million, a fraction of its former reach. The parent company, now called Trusted Media Brands, has pivoted to digital and streaming video. The little magazine that once outsold everything but the Bible is still around, but it's a (should we say it?) condensed digest of what it was. _Did you grow up reading Reader's Digest? At its peak in the 1970s, it reached more than 17 million U.S. subscribers and tens of millions more worldwide, making it the most widely read magazine on Earth. DeWitt Wallace dreamed up the idea while recovering from shrapnel wounds in World War I: to condense the best magazine articles into one pocket-sized digest. pictured at the link, self-published the first issue in February 1922 from a basement beneath a Greenwich Village speakeasy, mailing circulars on their wedding day to drum up charter subscriptions at $3 each. It worked. By the 1950s, Reader's Digest was a cultural institution, and not just for the articles. Millions of Americans grew up flipping to - swapping jokes from Life in These United States and , and testing themselves with the monthly Word Power vocabulary quiz. The Reader 's Digest Condensed Books series, launched in 1950, became a living-room staple of its own, delivering abridged bestsellers by direct mail for nearly five decades before being renamed Select Editions in 1997. Today, the U.S. print edition still publishes about six times a year with a circulation of around 1.6 million, a fraction of its former reach. The parent company, now called Trusted Media Brands, has pivoted to digital and streaming video. The little magazine that once outsold everything but the Bible is still around, but it's a (should we say it?) condensed digest of what it was. Did you grow up reading Reader's Digest? ## No Drugs in Houston Shooting Van
The crystal-like substance that FBI agents spotted in Lorenzo Salgado Araujo's work van after an ICE agent shot him fatally [tested negative for narcotics](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOgyAYhJ9Gb5hfQNQDh7146173aFB-hAShkb-1fftNm-4T7HUymZlvfi7zxYQY0vZtdtT0cHlOeJaIRHjMKdvjtpWQfL4Vyqn4nCmk7T5z4IpBz7iarQnxOcva6gXs2Nao237oQIlBQO21WkYFpmt74_qxkwOMYrRgnOukxFXxOuhXGPRctS0IKRqzghhaRCeAr90ClQS0gfLRkEfChykuPvMdj2bNex21J7qWSnxVfKr4dJ5n4_KDq8_ml6ni04uq4tNHZGFF9kfDym0pZNKKLGVib2S2I3mzXz2S2UPC-tD2eoYYQ1F9JWHbTYjvfvrfa3fNfwMAAP__DOKFMg), the Harris County District Attorney's Office confirmed Friday. Salgado Araujo's family said all along that the bags held a [homemade electrolyte mix](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O3DAMhU8jdzJoyn9TqEjjbtOmNDiSbCsriwtJtmdy-sBBbrAdARL8vvd-fcwf5IOP60_anS6vheforhxcKS7NkW061uzjxkcuHPPGXHxczxkBewmDxH625MN7biurn2AfTeV0M4wd9GpUUG16VN34WNA-qAczqq4f0NhFdYhPIAWm8vp-BgP2TQOqVTUZUGPj3KIATfcE0YKzvnCqy-aKe1FewptPl2rDexX0VspXFuqHwEngdF1XbYI3n_hf-r4SON2xBE6BDQWB080UOMFwz-29ZxkpGS7eZLnwEa30UQZOLv5hmSmsZFlSouM3Z3lx-pQnRWk4rsnlfPFOUWZ635Aqaft1-RB87gfRwrqTD_9sy_c6PjX-DQAA__8aKpKp) of granulated salt, lemon, and water that outdoor crews use in Texas heat. Their attorney, Ruby Powers, said full lab results are due Monday. Homeland Security has said the 52-year-old tried to run over an agent during a targeted enforcement operation in Magnolia Park on July 7. Men riding in the van dispute that account, saying the agents' vehicles struck them first. District Attorney Sean Teare had already said the drug question had no bearing on whether deadly force was justified. The FBI [has not released](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb8Gd7PCwNqbgiIN3Uub0hrDYKOwsAJsr_8-8ir5gteNNJq595zfX9MXhhjS8gufpNvb5ynRUSO1RmVK2ZVtqSGteastp7rm3EJa9klwMQAfQQyTwxDPSXVOz9z96DvS_fi480E-JO9WjV7N0ivryT1QurlHq-guleRKCWddF_T1jI9i6Hsulbyh5fLRE3nJhb3PnClOLrRcbm2lRm-sPp55p3Kz-dlFvbb2qkz-ZMIwYY7juP2p2K4lE-aiYcJ8zpgwVxQTho_XrJgwdZtrw2QJfN6Sg5BgxwToGxX4hw3BEvxnhwNravARAw4Bk4OtQqEX1DPuAWHBYgNCxZMJ0xXtXkeIMdRhZIovTwzxU7x9T_euxd8AAAD__7Gdl0E) its own results.
## Paxton Wins Discord Child-Safety Order
A Collin County [judge ordered Discord](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8Gd0R4-LFdUGxDd7fd0uJnHLOLIQIS37z9ynmF2410Rkc635-v9cvGFPP9tz1Q9--trBnPlrB3rGsuoT7vLea9PFsvue2l9JjvrxUYKMomCmoNNqb3KoagHQvLOKAep1kyxWfOhl2LiYstODWPOKKSYlFykn5Wk18QnJdD1JeMTaDGkXHBb9YzPo-IG2fgpWNEMAyxl3rrO3b8tm1L7_LCevPlGJLee380wn8RMATMeZ63K-HE1pfrg4CxtUefkIC5CAGTireJgPnYCJgQmy810GY37G96oG3Pio1-OP0Xw3Uej1JtfdOY_z6z77FkAgbUQnFRGzqw1KEcqfBuoU45Tr230nsnN8vFUHV4nDGl2NREBLsfNqZPQP_Z7C8N_wMAAP__3nSY7w) to give every Texas user the same age verification and default safety settings the company already provides in the United Kingdom within 90 days. Attorney General Ken Paxton's office [sued Discord on May 22](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL8OmzAQxp8GNiNjDCSDhy5s6doRGfswpzo-ZF8gvH2VqH2Cbt_w0_fv12N-WIyYwk_7BMPvleYEZ4nADHlO5PMrFEwbvQpTKhsRYwrHrKQahByFGmZvMV6zrr1ZpL-3NZh2vPVy6G6drDfT65vXer2P0ko19Isf771upXJO28WPS43mYyZHNbSt7HTXWCe7WwuwdlK5fpGVluCRKTe8AcPbljVedEBuHD3raDbmvVTdj0pNlZrO82y-kGWmnOAKkCDb2AQ6KjV91lVqyhDBFvjIf5z4C4rfkMRu30xJFHCvDEVsWJgyOhEh2CgOdEz5EitlhykIj8VR9mLPxOBYfPOF2zD6DKnOxu8nxohlGCstw9Ni_Hbn_3v8MOpPAAAA___zC5zN) under the Deceptive Trade Practices Act, arguing the platform told parents it was safe by design while defaulting children's accounts to its weakest settings. The agreed injunction followed a two-day hearing. Under the order, messages from strangers route to a separate request inbox, sensitive content stays locked for Texas teens unless Discord confirms an adult, and adult-only spaces close to anyone not age-verified. Discord said it agreed with the attorney general's office on steps that support a safer experience for teens. The company filed 489,782 reports of suspected child exploitation to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children last year.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | This is not just another feud. # [Grateful for Union Support from Pennsylvania Machinists and Pennsylvania AFL-CIO](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/07/26/grateful-for-union-support-from-pennsylvania-machinists-and-pennsylvania-afl-cio/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)

By **Elizabeth Farnham** on July 26, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 07.26.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=199192071aad11bf8ec950e26f3bab3970d2a44b5269cd43bccdb6604f00275c&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8352&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=d7632910dfe4476806378ec7e472e0d6&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=96e54c27c73346fd3013b072abcd04d3)**
---
| **Pennsylvania Machinists Stand With Beth!**
---
| |
---
*Update* The Pennsylvania AFL-CIO just endorsed my campaign too!
---
Many, many thanks to the Pennsylvania Machinists Union (Pennsylvania division of International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers) for their generous donation to this campaign.
---
Special thanks to Eastern Pennsylvania MNPL Director Bob Miller for handing the check to me personally.
---
Because of the sacrifices of the IAM and Pennsylvania AFL-CIO members, as well as those of other organized workers, we have the time off, both paid and unpaid, minimum wages, and safer work conditions that previous generations could only dream about.
---
These benefits weren’t handed out willingly by benevolent employers, they were fought for every step of the way by unionized workers.
---
I’m proud to stand with this IAM, the Pennsylvanai AFL-CIO, and other unions across our district, state, and nation. And every meeting, every picket line, every strike they hold is a validation of our sacred First Amendment rights.
---
When elected, I’ll work for them by voting for the PRO Act and other legislation that protects the rights of workers to organize, have benefits, and experience even safer working conditions.
---
Thank you to the Juniata Civic Association for their wonderful Community Day! It was a lovely event and I was glad to meet so many voters.
---
Thank you also to volunteers Angie and Chris for helping with the set-up, Billy, Pam and others for staffing the booth, and to Team Member Eileen for managing the volunteers and teardown in the afternoon.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=6a78816ae7646419ea359fb8c16ccbc82c694f1d59ef03501e5600ebd15f0648&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8352&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=82b06c13967d9bb1f482014e2b03f735&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=96e54c27c73346fd3013b072abcd04d3) !

| **PLEASE CALL YOUR SENATORS!**
---
| |
---
Call your senator to discourage them from voting for Todd Blanche as U.S. Attorney General.
---
While only the confirmation hearing for the Senate Judiciary Committee began this week, it is imperative ALL U.S. senators understand that Blanche is unfit to serve before the vote has any chance to head to the Senate floor.
---
As Trump’s former private lawyer, Blanche has been operating as Acting U.S. Attorney General in Trump’s favor by suppressing the full release of the [#EpsteinFiles](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=a86bdb8c41f665935c4f20acc686f6d79d497bf786b3e4b2f3eac098cfb29aa9&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8352&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=7a1434e3b5b6287e927ec18fc566c8c8&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=96e54c27c73346fd3013b072abcd04d3) .
---
He is hell-bent on persecuting those whom Trump sees as his political enemies, like Cassidy Hutchinson, who testified in the January 6th hearings.
---
Blanche pardoned several January 6th terrorists and under his “leadership,” nearly a quarter of all Department of Justice staff resigned.
---
Our country is already more vulnerable to our enemies, both foreign and domestic, than ever before.
---
Our Pennsylvania senators can be reached at the following DC numbers:
---
John Fetterman: (202)-224-4254
---
Dave McCormick: (202) 224-6324
---
Tell the to vote NO on Blanche whenever it should come to them for a vote.
---
Thank you for all you do to save our country from Trump’s cruelty and incompetence!
---

| | **ENDORSEMENT ALERT**
---
| |
---
Many, many thanks to the National Women’s Political Caucus for their recent endorsement of my campaign.
---
This is the group that was (from their website) “...founded in 1971 by these strong, prominent women:
---
Gloria Steinem, author, lecturer and founding editor of Ms. Magazine
---
Shirley Chisholm, activist, former Congresswoman (1969-1983) and 1st black woman to run for president of the United States
---
Betty Friedan, activist and author of The Feminine Mystique
---
Fannie Lou Hamer, voting and women’s rights activist and civil rights leader
---
Bella Abzug, former Congresswoman (1971-1977) and former president of Women USA
---
And about 300 of their closest friends from across the country.”
---
I am proud to stand with them in this fight for equality, including agency over our own bodies and equal pay for equal work. I also appreciate their inclusion of trans women in their cause.
---
Why do they include trans women?

Because trans women aren’t the threat to women and girls that Trump and his cronies make them out to be.

“We joined National Women’s Law Center and 170+ organizations to condemn Trump’s cruel and lawless anti-trans executive order. This order doesn’t “protect” women from any real threat. It actively endangers all women.” January 2025

AIPAC donations?

Absolutely not.

Expanding defense technology cooperation and integration between U.S. and Israeli militaries?

Not that either.

While Israel was attacked by the terrorist group, Hamas, in 2023 and was within her right to retaliate against Hamas, Israeli forces have clearly abused that power to create what Amnesty International labels a “genocide” – killing civilians, including women and children, indiscriminately.
---
From Wikipedia –
---
“The Gaza genocide is the ongoing,[19] intentional, and systematic destruction of the Palestinian people in the Gaza Strip carried out by Israel during the Gaza war. It encompasses mass killings, the targeted killing of children (who account for 30% of those killed),[20][21][22] deliberate starvation, infliction of serious bodily and mental harm, and prevention of births. Other acts include blockading, destroying civilian infrastructure, destroying healthcare facilities, killing healthcare workers and aid-seekers, causing mass forced displacement, committing sexual violence, and destroying educational, religious, and cultural sites.[23] The genocide has been recognised by a United Nations special committee[24] and commission of inquiry,[23] the International Association of Genocide Scholars,[25][26] multiple human rights groups,[c] state governments, numerous genocide studies and international law scholars,[32][33] and other experts.[34]”

The Palestinians are suffering at the hands and hardened hearts of the Israelis who keep encroaching on the previously-agreed upon yellow line.
---
“For Palestinians, these shifting markers are a daily reality of forced displacement. The Government Media Office in Gaza has recorded 3,795 Israeli violations of the ceasefire, resulting in 1,168 Palestinians killed since the “ceasefire” agreement in October last year. UN data indicates that roughly a third of these deaths occurred in areas near this advancing demarcation line.”
---
We cannot trust Israel not to abuse more power, and therefore , the Palestinian people, with integration of American defense technology.
---
It’s horrendous that our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, voted for the 2027 budget bill with section 219 intact, but since he has accepted AIPAC money, though not a lot, it’s hardly a surprise.

Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd so that I can properly represent us and, with other caring legislators, stop Israel’s genocide of Palestinians.

As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you... | | | or | By Elizabeth Farnham on July 26, 2026 | District Round-up 07.26.26 Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here: | Pennsylvania Machinists Stand With Beth! | | Update The Pennsylvania AFL-CIO just endorsed my campaign too! Many, many thanks to the Pennsylvania Machinists Union (Pennsylvania division of International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers) for their generous donation to this campaign. Special thanks to Eastern Pennsylvania MNPL Director Bob Miller for handing the check to me personally. Because of the sacrifices of the IAM and Pennsylvania AFL-CIO members, as well as those of other organized workers, we have the time off, both paid and unpaid, minimum wages, and safer work conditions that previous generations could only dream about. These benefits weren’t handed out willingly by benevolent employers, they were fought for every step of the way by unionized workers. I’m proud to stand with this IAM, the Pennsylvanai AFL-CIO, and other unions across our district, state, and nation. And every meeting, every picket line, every strike they hold is a validation of our sacred First Amendment rights. When elected, I’ll work for them by voting for the PRO Act and other legislation that protects the rights of workers to organize, have benefits, and experience even safer working conditions. Thank you to the Juniata Civic Association for their wonderful Community Day! It was a lovely event and I was glad to meet so many voters. Thank you also to volunteers Angie and Chris for helping with the set-up, Billy, Pam and others for staffing the booth, and to Team Member Eileen for managing the volunteers and teardown in the afternoon. Together, we ! | | | PLEASE CALL YOUR SENATORS! | | Call your senator to discourage them from voting for Todd Blanche as U.S. Attorney General. While only the confirmation hearing for the Senate Judiciary Committee began this week, it is imperative ALL U.S. senators understand that Blanche is unfit to serve before the vote has any chance to head to the Senate floor. As Trump’s former private lawyer, Blanche has been operating as Acting U.S. Attorney General in Trump’s favor by suppressing the full release of the . He is hell-bent on persecuting those whom Trump sees as his political enemies, like Cassidy Hutchinson, who testified in the January 6th hearings. Blanche pardoned several January 6th terrorists and under his “leadership,” nearly a quarter of all Department of Justice staff resigned. Our country is already more vulnerable to our enemies, both foreign and domestic, than ever before. Our Pennsylvania senators can be reached at the following DC numbers: John Fetterman: (202)-224-4254 Dave McCormick: (202) 224-6324 Tell the to vote NO on Blanche whenever it should come to them for a vote. Thank you for all you do to save our country from Trump’s cruelty and incompetence! Together, we | | ENDORSEMENT ALERT | | Many, many thanks to the National Women’s Political Caucus for their recent endorsement of my campaign. This is the group that was (from their website) “...founded in 1971 by these strong, prominent women: Gloria Steinem, author, lecturer and founding editor of Ms. Magazine Shirley Chisholm, activist, former Congresswoman (1969-1983) and 1st black woman to run for president of the United States Betty Friedan, activist and author of The Feminine Mystique Fannie Lou Hamer, voting and women’s rights activist and civil rights leader Bella Abzug, former Congresswoman (1971-1977) and former president of Women USA And about 300 of their closest friends from across the country.” I am proud to stand with them in this fight for equality, including agency over our own bodies and equal pay for equal work. I also appreciate their inclusion of trans women in their cause. Why do they include trans women? Because trans women aren’t the threat to women and girls that Trump and his cronies make them out to be. “We joined National Women’s Law Center and 170+ organizations to condemn Trump’s cruel and lawless anti-trans executive order. This order doesn’t “protect” women from any real threat. It actively endangers all women.” January 2025 “Banning trans and intersex women athletes is never about fairness; it’s about exclusion. Everyone deserves the right to play, compete and belong. National Women’s Law Center” – February 2025 Together, we and Equality! | This Gen Xer Says, “Just Say No to AIPAC “ | | AIPAC donations? Absolutely not. Expanding defense technology cooperation and integration between U.S. and Israeli militaries? Not that either. While Israel was attacked by the terrorist group, Hamas, in 2023 and was within her right to retaliate against Hamas, Israeli forces have clearly abused that power to create what Amnesty International labels a “genocide” – killing civilians, including women and children, indiscriminately. From Wikipedia – “The Gaza genocide is the ongoing,[19] intentional, and systematic destruction of the Palestinian people in the Gaza Strip carried out by Israel during the Gaza war. It encompasses mass killings, the targeted killing of children (who account for 30% of those killed),[20][21][22] deliberate starvation, infliction of serious bodily and mental harm, and prevention of births. Other acts include blockading, destroying civilian infrastructure, destroying healthcare facilities, killing healthcare workers and aid-seekers, causing mass forced displacement, committing sexual violence, and destroying educational, religious, and cultural sites.[23] The genocide has been recognised by a United Nations special committee[24] and commission of inquiry,[23] the International Association of Genocide Scholars,[25][26] multiple human rights groups,[c] state governments, numerous genocide studies and international law scholars,[32][33] and other experts.[34]” The Palestinians are suffering at the hands and hardened hearts of the Israelis who keep encroaching on the previously-agreed upon yellow line. “For Palestinians, these shifting markers are a daily reality of forced displacement. The Government Media Office in Gaza has recorded 3,795 Israeli violations of the ceasefire, resulting in 1,168 Palestinians killed since the “ceasefire” agreement in October last year. UN data indicates that roughly a third of these deaths occurred in areas near this advancing demarcation line.” We cannot trust Israel not to abuse more power, and therefore , the Palestinian people, with integration of American defense technology. It’s horrendous that our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, voted for the 2027 budget bill with section 219 intact, but since he has accepted AIPAC money, though not a lot, it’s hardly a surprise. Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd so that I can properly represent us and, with other caring legislators, stop Israel’s genocide of Palestinians. Together, we and HUMAN RIGHTS! Sources: & | Farnham vs. Joyce vs. Environment | | How does Joyce vote on the Environment? Horribly. The League of Conservation Voters gives him a LIFETIME score of 3%. Joyce doesn’t care about being a steward of the Earth for future generations, but I do. You can read my priority of the Environment on my website, linked below. Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, in November. Together, we and the Earth! Source: | South Mountain Fair | | (Photo credit: D.F.) It was a great evening to speak with voters. Thank you Adams County Democratic Committee for hosting a table at the South Mountain Fair. Thank you to the voters who stopped by, shared what was on your heart, and listened to my responses. I even got to catch up with fellow candidates Kathleen Pratt and Todd Crawley. Together, we and real representation! | Bowling With Dems Many thanks to the Perry County Democrats for hosting a community bowling event yesterday afternoon at Perry County Lanes in New Bloomfield. It was a great way to meet voters in the community and hear about the issues most important to them. When I am elected to Congress, I will continue to listen to you about the issues that affect you most so that I, along with other caring legislators, can draft the legislation that improves the lives of Everyday Americans. Because that’s what a real U.S. Representative does, she exercises the Will of the People, not cedes power to the executive branch. You can fire our current multimillionaire representative by voting for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd. Even though charitable donations will not meet the overwhelming need of food assistance and healthcare for lower income Americans, these charities are a stopgap until I am elected to the U.S. House of Representatives and can legislate helpful federal programs as well as prevent a rapacious president from illegally impounding the congressionally-approved funds for those programs. We can't afford to take a single day, a single dollar, or a single vote for granted over these next 100 days. Thank you for your support, Chris New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240976%2E444211%2EcCcmbp)
As Executive Director of Powered by People, I get to see firsthand the incredible work our staff and volunteers do every day to push back against voter suppression here in Texas.
So far this year, our organizers have been out in full force - registering and staying in touch with over 25,000 voters at concerts, on college campuses, at local coffee shops, and more statewide.
On top of that, we’ve personally reached out to over 250,000 eligible Texans to help them vote by mail, and over 100,000 Texans who moved recently to make sure their voter registration moved with them so they don’t lose their voice come November.
With exactly 100 days until Election Day, Beto and our team are finalizing plans to hit the road in September, October, and November to reach college students all across Texas.
**To make this travel and organizing blitz happen, we need to raise $43,000.**
Here’s why this matters so much right now: young Texans are one of the most under-registered groups in the state — and one of the most decisive if they show up.
With high-stakes statewide races on the line, including James Talarico taking on Ken Paxton for Senate and Gina Hinojosa running for Governor, every single vote will matter.
Winning these races comes down to one thing: reaching young voters where they are and ensuring they are registered and ready to vote before Election Day.
[**If you can, will you donate $3 today to help get Beto on the road and make sure our organizers have the resources they need to register as many voters as possible before Election Day?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260726.gc4cCr&refcode=ema20260726-240976&t=3&akid=240976%2E444211%2EcCcmbp)

With exactly 100 days until Election Day, Beto and our team are finalizing plans to hit the road in September, October, and November to reach college students all across Texas. To make this travel and organizing blitz happen, we need to raise $43,000. Here’s why this matters so much right now: young Texans are one of the most under-registered groups in the state — and one of the most decisive if they show up. With high-stakes statewide races on the line, including James Talarico taking on Ken Paxton for Senate and Gina Hinojosa running for Governor, every single vote will matter. Winning these races comes down to one thing: reaching young voters where they are and ensuring they are registered and ready to vote before Election Day. Thank you for being in this fight with us, Aimee Prudhomme

I've seen at every level of our politics how nasty things can get. Toxic. Useless. Spiteful. Divorced from any sense of getting things done and making life better for people.
But throughout this campaign, I've also met people who practice a different kind of politics -- people who give into what my mom would call generous impulses. People who care about building relationships, regardless of party. Who want to understand and get to know the other leaders in our community, not just the ones who agree with them. Who don't care about scoring points for their side, but just want good things for the place we all call home.
These are city council members and county commissioners. Former candidates and community advocates. Neighbors who show up to the same meetings, again and again, long after the cameras leave. For all of them, the bottom line is the same: making things better.
It sounds naive. I know that. But it's real here. And it's the kind of politics we need -- the kind I want to be part of, the kind we need in Congress.
We're 100 days out from the election.
100 days doesn't feel like much time. But it's enough time to knock on every door that matters. Enough time to have the conversations that change minds. Enough time to build the momentum we need to change our politics.
So if you're with me -- if you want to help build a politics of grace, of generous impulses, of getting things done regardless of party -- then join us.
Here's how:

# Just The Truth
Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor, Turning Point USA, is highlighting its nationwide effort to equip students with the resources to launch campus chapters and support the next generation of young conservative leaders. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
* * *
| | | | [](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGLEdBU2X4nhp69nLgUlbcwZggEqfKazHIw8sOtlLD1EIg7bNoqFYB1-7aCD-yGv4VptB6YrjoRb-n2QheDAjpEQ/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h1/h001.9ifmaHdeTM1qs0OUZyjYtz8O5-nkIDsUh0LIkrJx-xQ)

| | Friend,
---
I want to give you a picture of what’s really happening right now — not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGKbx8O0TMVyg9X4VEB6pBuIsPNUPKYXfpfptBXKEWcWaz2JmgqjCJC6Vo80oiV4USTBiCGyZdwpbE6ILqVgWLEQ/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h2/h001.3d8mFhvENEjow4hamFoKBc5GWd1ljPtXKoz-fxWCyac)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren’t sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They’re already claimed. And we don’t have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation — they want to start something, and they’re asking us to help them do it.

That’s where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don’t say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn’t getting students the tools — it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that’s all changing.

Now, we’re seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs — Charlie’s alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom — not because it’s easy, but because they’ve decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGRRz7_cKBEfgk012rHT27XN7Pus7FE9vx6n5xG6Dx57u14f6c4Pf2CnGMSKH_cuc07klGwa7c7qCgjzG6fzJZgg/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h3/h001.CqkqEx_JjmNxSaw5N2BUvwcvEt32R-2ZyNKvC_gZngU)
---
That’s not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it’s not isolated growth anymore.

**We’re now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That’s real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we’re still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What’s different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously — not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGQW5onCxP5w1u4UAOK_JLYZwfC-2nYlS655Rk9FV0of-RMqrQXrRsUz6rKCIw6EtmkFTJ-JwVSJYlTEHfJL0Xyg/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h4/h001.1eAFPdNbWCh10Kl5RQxLxY_I1ZG99uaQs85iK5zT_0I)
---
That kind of expansion doesn’t happen slowly.

It stacks quickly — and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that’s where we’re stretched.

We’re not lacking interest or momentum.

We’re working to keep up with both.

_So here’s how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up — they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you’ll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, “I want to start something here.”

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student’s hands today?](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGLUv_D-PZsndkjdGqI1L8RMRvl14m34VYrKtiaeihD6j-S5ifKOIYHZANEnEvzlHrlhvSDvRYkmEbJA3LeLl5Uw/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h5/h001.gWIca6Yq4meDBFKNqo0hQKPFyGCCZIW9vEcMJQxLnHA)**
---
[**Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6_It_HwwR2kK3CjKeiy9qBM8usB2znQYzxIZAgSM13vP5xJY93U1R8hcWmcCtyH65h_SeWe0lHRdV6RuoFluF8PRUhyqUdgLNljy9Lrp4Zk8Pl4XdDlAdD2ORzNuP_X5Li4IykFh763rarr3KPJBJtpCzIwY4_VLnLA_PGlYzvzgr6_OiNfo-U1Pmc3dZC8Un0JELqANTSwrC1VEZZqJMM_kyUd0hRTgLWDdJiz9LzxGL85_AEhn8CVn2mXOkhcT1cs4sD8e6llu9fvId0wxjUv0aqxZ5RFtqTlC1I_qfwpv6hUaggRcrx2cQfsWco6pIA/4sn/XCEuZVwNTGCL7U54FRDg7Q/h6/h001.TWHjgvpxvt4X2gD5k5QycQsiCFxHniQQwXrGB_DGF7g)
---
Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines.

That’s how we keep saying “yes” when the next student steps forward.

That’s how this movement actually scales.

Because the reality is, the demand is here now.

My name is Jeff Allen, and I'm the Campaign Manager here at Roy Cooper for North Carolina.
In April, I updated you on where this race stood, and how our team is approaching the campaign trail. Last month, I explained how the Supreme Court's monumental campaign finance decision would affect this election.
And with just 100 days remaining before Election Day, here's exactly where we stand.
We have just 100 to talk to every voter, knock on every door and finish this campaign strong.
As you may have seen, the polls are tightening. A recent Public Policy Poll (PPP) shows us leading Michael Whatley by ONLY 4 points. As is often the case in North Carolina, we know that this will be an extremely close race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ed5447b-3dd8-439d-8d05-af20ab9d05db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b20706c2-950a-4448-a0b5-f7e5f89906fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So we're working hard every day until Election Day to show voters just how important this race is. North Carolina hasn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 2008. History isn't on our side. But every ounce of support and every dollar we raise right now goes directly to changing that.
We need to send a committed, independent leader to Washington who actually cares about North Carolinians -- not a DC insider and big oil lobbyist who cares more about his personal portfolio than the needs of working families.
Roy's record speaks for itself. Four terms as Attorney General. Two terms as Governor. He's spent his career fighting for North Carolina and he's running for Senate to put working families first. Roy has spent his career fighting for the people of North Carolina. Michael Whatley has spent it fighting for the wealthy and well-connected.
The Republican dark money machine is strong, and Whatley already has the full force of the GOP behind him. **Make no mistake -- the GOP is coming for this seat.**
So far, GOP Super PACs have committed nearly $100 MILLION to trying to buy this race. That number will only grow in the next 100 days. The Supreme Court has cleared the way for the GOP to dump millions more into attacking our campaign. That means more seven figure ad buys, more attempts to out-organize us, and probably even visits from Donald Trump to North Carolina.
This race will be decided by a slim margin, and that margin will be decided by what we do over the next 100 days.
Our campaign was built as a grassroots movement, and that is how we intend to win it -- through widespread organizing, direct voter contact and a people-powered effort from folks like you.
Whether you can [chip in](https://substack.com/redirect/b20706c2-950a-4448-a0b5-f7e5f89906fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few dollars, [register](https://substack.com/redirect/d2a35806-0990-43f3-91a2-d4cacb77b9ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to vote, [volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/44b87f74-c2df-4ff5-a694-099c20717a58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to knock on doors or call voters, every effort counts. Thank you for standing with this campaign, and thank you for reading.
Jeff

In April, I updated you on where this race stood, and how our team is approaching the campaign trail. North Carolina hasn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 2008. History isn't on our side. But every ounce of support and every dollar we raise right now goes directly to changing that. | | Peter, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e365cef15bb64f4a97225543d5665cd4&_e=aJYHJKCa2TGxQP4ytDQVPsHnhWH39KDcpSBmK43sBMkTtUzKNgGkDB7HFUsKkSKTe_6jBCK2wrCt3uAQnTozAX8M4bl6LUdaKr9f1-fi3yvQk6tTm_nnfWpWTDw1wHiKv7qISfWsL3br6_68qM0GUpdaUjSWuIxew1lLgc5CWYIP3voKe2Ll2PBDXl0vL8PWh6NTE3BsRuL2S3LBTzUhWGl5jKwc043THj7NtBOL5nKluoQhIRXVqOdlHSnmL1xV76zwSR5kZ8W6bEXKt6LxzxjORC_i6ZFeyZVZZILCAagJY3xzsuyvtOM58NuiDID5nEMUNsU4TKbQ4cPbzdmoNIERiVMFOrge5Sxbwb1Cpdaa6NwElWP1JbzxJBgqpFcPNFfh1dsiglA67TbZMiaJq9NVs4zfaflFY0ZoInywuttap2KXmglL9KXhYjitmR8xrvOZ-OpBl2pbSovbC8V7DvFKAmnmdNa2WsQ8kZ9_mOOEToJ61iBIWU6bRxzDfhr0fggnU7nXF3bpe2ByYYQ1tDmXnCtAdsf-xOYSuib5nhNNz2kEoOyhAWtCXyAgPvebv-zUpF3sw8NJk0BYbGRRRrlPmn1EjtAEzMzItCe8Z-dsiThqZ6PoqUpkYc1Mataabwzvj8PQyDv0d1OiDxHElE7WiAci6CY66OrCMc8qNJX3qnylrkTFOBpZ64eUiA7BS07wh6fRoibA2TwuaRukRTHIiwU28HVTfMoU29roZsM%3D)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...

| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e365cef15bb64f4a97225543d5665cd4&_e=aJYHJKCa2TGxQP4ytDQVPsHnhWH39KDcpSBmK43sBMkTtUzKNgGkDB7HFUsKkSKTe_6jBCK2wrCt3uAQnTozAX8M4bl6LUdaKr9f1-fi3yvQk6tTm_nnfWpWTDw1wHiKv7qISfWsL3br6_68qM0GUpdaUjSWuIxew1lLgc5CWYIP3voKe2Ll2PBDXl0vL8PWh6NTE3BsRuL2S3LBTzUhWGl5jKwc043THj7NtBOL5nKluoQhIRXVqOdlHSnmL1xV25MgJYBbVRsysrFIGIDKaSa7h-klkyk7NtvcDlnnG_Qd6U6K1KKnkvYKVKbP7sBb3tC7ny2SVOspMLJDBEZP4cinCDWy3GzRoeGs4eziMpjssWy_-BFBFc9Bf8lmugDfLrNkGNPdlP-SiKCSOrMaktV3Yz2Nq0wUmoEqegv3KVFVVv7yc9xzf4fL7Sl5QdpkWZUzRCcB1ZhnUN2t8hqO6YW0B693hmXKxv6LOovg9d4GVxVe-xLov2mDGFySw8SwxRfORXuWYCLQks0r_b-Y90oUi6qPZHhm_1k0nphAL83bNmZPGMydcGn4RZlmyfcSweLdjxmvLh9NsM5q_0-YaU_ffWlYSUACPdnxWneKNFzNcjYVNWDMhP8_13tl2F-T-mlNrFN0UUydDzR5XCWInRuTArqGX8YHC8yqNsYDGeGSRj65_UAAHxkDEULpx0h9SKHEuITGVkoUBj0gdy1z44bR20r-5412B9CiSkXNKIA%3D)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!_**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=e365cef15bb64f4a97225543d5665cd4&_e=aJYHJKCa2TGxQP4ytDQVPsHnhWH39KDcpSBmK43sBMkTtUzKNgGkDB7HFUsKkSKTe_6jBCK2wrCt3uAQnTozAX8M4bl6LUdaKr9f1-fi3yvQk6tTm_nnfWpWTDw1wHiKv7qISfWsL3br6_68qM0GUpdaUjSWuIxew1lLgc5CWYIP3voKe2Ll2PBDXl0vL8PWh6NTE3BsRuL2S3LBTzUhWGl5jKwc043THj7NtBOL5nKluoQhIRXVqOdlHSnmL1xVcQb1Tkd89mUToOqotWEEAy74emhLTycSgEY0NNu34KNfoQYHmktxjb9T8hOXkkYJfKMcH-luWZ45_dGKBegvGO0JP86mfZcPeoxrd-i9Y8HLDJDmFFmpjphFpMU74-Xn5eWyXCczGKKCsiN3vBSHkohxzPQ0YDHc58ZWhNkQv18EBp4K-7AxficBIQjHDiBIx4P4SCFINPvuKXx2mWZpE3AxJDTCTRNosc6qTPLiE2CH64Vga6rPy0I6jLiW9Aix0SHZgfstqO5k2yrzfrw3py2bc6-SU1sHWTIiVX3zA376lbzkFir8WTX1McZ2JhKoUqXULcP56Pmh3OoTrhBpZoA1oDs-VHshcQbWDgOyCNiVip-zs729o1y6mVJXT7_9qmDWRaZXrX1D5Bhb2CDccIETtFYYFtwVciDgtPIusxN1jJcK9tRfi4qxxAQfq56ikTKT9leJVuur9FhBEvLT9ULtGEaIZ42xjlys0LvUkec%3D) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that onebit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile.
