Hey Peter,
At the beginning of this campaign, I biked 180 miles across our gerrymandered congressional district to meet people where they were and learn firsthand what our community needs from our representative in Congress.
Today marks 100 days until Election Day, and I cannot believe the journey we’ve been on together over the last 18 months.
Over the next 100 days, I’m going to be giving it my all, because the ride is only uphill from here. Here’s the thing: I could really use you by my side from here on out.
We know how much of our current government is answering to corporations and the wealthiest of our country, and that’s just not right. The current crew in Congress hasn’t done much to help the folks back home. Instead, they’ve just caused prices to rise across the board by going along with tariffs, the war, and so much more. All this has done is put more burdens on our communities.
I’m not running to expand my stock portfolio or get in with the corporate interests. I am running to make real change.
And I really need your support. As we reach out to voters over the next 100 days, we’ll need the resources to educate voters on exactly what is at stake in this election. subject: The clock starts now
body:
Give us a chance to explain, Peter.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&source=&t=1&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)
| | | |
---
$20.26, Peter.
That’s how much we’re asking folks to chip in today in honor of it being 100 days out from Election Day. [**_Your grassroots support is the only way we can flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats. Can we count on your donation?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&amount=20.26&t=8&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)
| | [DONATE $20.26](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&amount=20.26&t=9&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)
---
Right now, experts say that Democrats have NO shot at winning back the Senate without flipping North Carolina – a seat that hasn’t gone blue since 2008. **Despite this _and_ the fact that President Trump has carried North Carolina each of the three times he’s run, the latest poll shows Roy with a slim lead.**
The momentum behind our campaign is growing by the day, in no small part because of grassroots support from people like you, Peter.
Here’s the problem: All of the progress we’re making to win this race has the GOP panicking. Dark-money super PACs are investing nearly $100 million so far to defeat us – and President Trump and his attack dog, Stephen Miller, are spreading lies about Roy to turn voters against him.
**With just 100 days to go until the election, we have a LOT of work to do to reach these voters and make sure they know the truth – and that takes serious resources. That’s why we’re asking so much of you today.**
[**_Peter, you haven’t chipped in to Roy’s campaign yet (that’s all right!). If you’re unable to contribute $20.26 today, will you give $5 – or even just a few bucks? We need new donors like you to join us so we can flip North Carolina and the Senate._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&amount=20.26&t=10&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)
Thank you so much for pitching in what you can at this critical moment.
Team Cooper
_If you've donated via check, mail or in-person event, thank you! Our system may not have processed your gift yet, but rest assured we have received it. Please note, if you have given through a spouse or another email or phone number, our records may not have transferred that information here. We are grateful for your support and no further action is required at this time._
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&t=2&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**_[Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk842&source=&t=3&akid=2322%2E124072%2EVnAxwY)_**

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: How I’m fighting back
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
These AI data centers guzzle massive amounts of water and energy, strain our power grids, drive up costs for everyday families, and are used to power mass surveillance.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260726-6516-footer&t=1&akid=6516%2E420207%2EuArsf3)
Peter,
Right now, tech billionaires and AI companies are spending millions to buy influence in our elections so they can build AI data centers in our communities—while ignoring the people who will have to live with the consequences.
**I’m fighting back—and I’ve taken them on before.**
I’ve stood up to demand that the biggest corporations in the world pay their fair share, protect workers, and stop treating our communities like an afterthought. And I’m not backing down now.
These AI data centers guzzle massive amounts of water and energy, strain our power grids, drive up costs for everyday families, and are used to power mass surveillance.
While communities are raising real concerns about noise, water use, and rising utility bills, too many politicians are looking the other way.
These companies are raking in extraordinary profits, and they’re not shy about using it to protect their bottom line and push out leaders who won’t play ball.
**That’s exactly why it’s so important that we pass a constitutional amendment to overturn _Citizens United_ and get big money out of our politics.** I’ve introduced the legislation to make it happen, but I’m counting on your help to keep up the fight.
I’ve never taken a dime of corporate PAC money, and I don’t have tech billionaires on speed dial to fund my campaign. This campaign is powered by grassroots supporters like you who pitch in $3 or whatever you can afford to keep us going.
[**So if you believe our communities deserve a voice, not just a bigger energy bill and a loud data center next door, will you chip in $3 or whatever you can today to help me keep standing up to corporate power?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260726-1.JyS-_I&refcode=em20260726-6516&amount=3&t=2&akid=6516%2E420207%2EuArsf3)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260726-1.JyS-_I&amount=3&refcode=em20260726-6516&t=21&akid=6516%2E420207%2EuArsf3)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Since we launched this campaign in October — and since I became the Democratic nominee for governor — we’ve seen an incredible wave of support from grassroots supporters like you.
This movement, powered by _everyday_ Texans — teachers, parents, business owners, electricians, plumbers, and so many more — has been the backbone of this campaign.
We’ve built this campaign the right way: with people who believe Texas deserves better and who are ready to fight for a future where working families, not wealthy special interests, come first.
But with just **100 days left** , it’s time to go all in.
In the weeks ahead, we will reach voters where they are — at their doors, in their communities, and across every corner of our state.

subject: They have expensive taste in Washington.

body:
D.C. insiders don't understand regular folks, but we're going to beat them anyway.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)

One thing I've noticed in Washington is that some people have expensive taste. Me? I've always been partial to the simple stuff.
I don't need a fancy steak dinner. I don't drink those $12 coffees with oat milk and little pictures drawn in the foam. And I sure as heck ain't hanging around those high-dollar Washington cocktail parties pretending to enjoy gluten-free abominations and caviars.
Give me a bag of boiled peanuts from a roadside stand and I'm a happy man.
Nowadays that'll cost you about five or six bucks, depending on who's running the stand.
And that got me thinking... If a thousand good folks like yourself skipped just one bag of boiled peanuts this week and sent that pocket change to my campaign instead, we'd have enough fuel to completely blow those slick, big-spending Washington liberals right out of the water.
So here's my ask: [Would you consider chipping in the cost of a bag of boiled peanuts today? Maybe $5. Maybe a little more if you're feeling generous.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._NH4ZiZl9N8VKfKkNVw)

I wrote this poem when I was 14.
Twenty years later, with the help of friends, I brought it back to life as a short film.
Art is moral communication across distance and time. Sometimes it carries what policy language cannot: the life inside the uniform. The family photograph in a pocket. The future friendship that never gets to exist. Two human beings ordered to become enemies before they have even had the chance to know one another.
My father served this country with honor. My husband served this country with honor. I know the courage, discipline, sacrifice, and love of country that military service can demand.
And I have every right--and every responsibility--to say this:
**War is terrible. It wounds human beings. It destroys families, futures, communities, and generations of possibility. We do not have to keep choosing it.**
Supporting our troops cannot mean endlessly sending them into wars designed by people who will never bear the cost themselves. Patriotism cannot mean silence while lives are spent, constitutional war powers are ignored, and hundreds of billions of dollars disappear into weapons systems and military contractors -- that then slaughter human beings and destroy infrastructure that took generations to build.
Privatized profits...socialized losses. **The military-industrial-political complex Eisenhower warned us about 80 years ago is still well and kicking, destroying our country in the process.**
We can honor service while opposing neverending wars.
We can defend this country without surrendering our humanity.
And we can invest our common wealth in the things that actually make people safe: healthcare, education, housing, nutritious food, climate resilience, dignified work, strong communities, and real care for veterans when they come home.
This is _Battlefield Compact_.
For every life war has taken--and every human future peace might still preserve.
Dignity, safety, opportunity -- **for all.**
Care. Courage. The Constitution.

I'm going to kill you

And I'm going to die.

I don't want to kill you.

I don't want to die.

You look like my nephew.

You look like a good commander.

We might have been friends.

I would have liked to learn from you.

On a field where strangers meet beneath a blood‐red sky,

Two hearts beat the same though they're ordered to comply.

If fate had been kinder, we'd have walked side by side --

But war makes brothers enemies, and both of us will die.

But here we are,

Obeying orders.

This is not who we are,

But who we have to be.

So I'll kill for my country

And I'll die for mine.

I'm going to kill you

And I'm going to die.

On a field where strangers meet beneath a blood‐red sky,

Two hearts beat the same though they're ordered to comply.

If fate had been kinder, we'd have walked side by side --

But war makes brothers enemies, and both of us will die.

clean_body: Watch now (3 mins) | Haunting song and poem on the human costs of war. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? | | Haunting song and poem on the human costs of war. | | | Jul 26 | | | | | | | | | | | | I wrote this poem when I was 14. Twenty years later, with the help of friends, I brought it back to life as a short film. Art is moral communication across distance and time. Sometimes it carries what policy language cannot: the life inside the uniform. The family photograph in a pocket. The future friendship that never gets to exist. Two human beings ordered to become enemies before they have even had the chance to know one another. My father served this country with honor. My husband served this country with honor. I know the courage, discipline, sacrifice, and love of country that military service can demand. And I have every right--and every responsibility--to say this: War is terrible. It wounds human beings. It destroys families, futures, communities, and generations of possibility. We do not have to keep choosing it. Supporting our troops cannot mean endlessly sending them into wars designed by people who will never bear the cost themselves. Patriotism cannot mean silence while lives are spent, constitutional war powers are ignored, and hundreds of billions of dollars disappear into weapons systems and military contractors -- that then slaughter human beings and destroy infrastructure that took generations to build. Privatized profits...socialized losses. The military-industrial-political complex Eisenhower warned us about 80 years ago is still well and kicking, destroying our country in the process. We can honor service while opposing neverending wars. We can defend this country without surrendering our humanity. And we can invest our common wealth in the things that actually make people safe: healthcare, education, housing, nutritious food, climate resilience, dignified work, strong communities, and real care for veterans when they come home. This is Battlefield Compact. For every life war has taken--and every human future peace might still preserve. Dignity, safety, opportunity -- for all. Care. Courage. The Constitution. " Battlefield Compact" I'm going to kill you And I'm going to die. I don't want to kill you. I don't want to die. You look like my nephew. You look like a good commander. We might have been friends. I would have liked to learn from you. On a field where strangers meet beneath a blood‐red sky, Two hearts beat the same though they're ordered to comply. If fate had been kinder, we'd have walked side by side -- But war makes brothers enemies, and both of us will die. But here we are, Obeying orders. This is not who we are, But who we have to be. So I'll kill for my country And I'll die for mine. I'm going to kill you And I'm going to die. On a field where strangers meet beneath a blood‐red sky, Two hearts beat the same though they're ordered to comply. If fate had been kinder, we'd have walked side by side -- But war makes brothers enemies, and both of us will die. name: Melanie Lucero For Congress
subject: She didn't write this one
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY MELANIE LUCERO FOR CONGRESS
body:
She writes her own emails. This is the one she didn't. Here's the Melanie I know.
| [ MELANIE LUCERO
FOR CONGRESS · VIRGINIA'S 5TH DISTRICT ](https://us.list-manage.com/5wKsTUrbvXa?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
A letter from Michael · July 26
# The Melanie I know.
Peter,This is Michael — Melanie's husband. Every email in this series, she wrote herself. This is the one she didn't.You've heard her story by now: the Marine Corps, the intelligence work, the business we built together at Lake Anna. What you haven't heard is what she's like when no cameras are on and no votes are on the line. So let me tell you.I've watched her take calls at ten o'clock at night from a first-time homebuyer in a panic — and treat that family's problem like it was a national emergency. Not because there was anything in it for her. Because that's the only way she knows how to do a job. The Marine Corps calls it mission focus. I just call it Melanie.I've also watched what this race costs her. We had a good life — a business we love, quiet mornings on the lake. She's walking away from a lot of that, taking a pay cut, and signing up for the nastiest arena in America. People ask me if she's tough enough for Washington. I have to laugh. Washington has no idea what's coming.And here's the thing about my wife: she will never just tell you what you want to hear. Sometimes she'll tell you exactly what you _don't_ want to hear — but it will always be the truth. She knows full well that a lot of people vote on "he seems nice." And even then, she'll look a voter straight in the eye and give them the truth they need, knowing they might set the facts aside and vote against her anyway. I've seen it time and time again: her opponent's supporters come at her with talking points and leave with facts. A lot of them cross over on the spot. Some stumble and fall back on "well... I like him." She'll take that trade every time, because respect earned with the truth lasts longer than affection won with a smile.So when she tells you your call will be answered and your problem will be treated like a mission — that's not a campaign line. She doesn't say anything she isn't prepared to back up.I'm not asking you to vote for her because I love her. I'm asking because I know exactly who shows up when things get hard — and the 5th District deserves to have her in its corner. | [See Her Service Record](https://us.list-manage.com/11QCNhbrmEi?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04)
---
Her record, in black and white — two minutes.
* * *
With respect,
Michael Boyce
Melanie's husband
**P.S.** She'd never ask this way, so I will: the primary is 9 days out, and every dollar goes to reaching voters. If you're able, [chip in](https://us.list-manage.com/3m5pssim4fQ?e=b859d69a85&c2id=840d926fa883d6ae62831c5dde7f0f04) — and I'll make sure she keeps writing these emails herself.
|

subject: Trump’s latest attack on me at the White House Correspondents' Dinner
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Schiff for Senate
body:
| FDR once said you can judge a person by the enemies he makes; by that standard I’m doing very well.

[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=6&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072626_WHcorrespondents&akid=10017%2E5257348%2EMKCblm)
Derek, Friday night, at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, the President of the United States spent part of his hour attacking me, telling the crowd he hated me, and repeating the same schoolyard taunts he has been using since I led his first impeachment: _“So they thought about going with a professional**clown** for entertainment, but Adam 'Shifty' Schiff was not available... He’s a terrible person, he’s a liar. I hate some people... I hate him, called him ‘**watermelon head** ’ because he has the largest head I’ve ever seen and the smallest neck. **Pencil neck**.”_ [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=13&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072626_WHcorrespondents&akid=10017%2E5257348%2EMKCblm) This is nothing new. Trump has done everything from calling me a crook and a traitor, to demanding I be jailed and coercing House Republicans into censuring me — and none of it has changed how I do my work. _But these attacks have their consequences, and result in political attacks, smear campaigns, corrupt DOJ investigations, and death threats._ This is how it works with Trump. When my colleagues made a video he didn’t like and that merely stated the law and constitution — you don’t have to obey an illegal order — he called them traitors too, and sic’d the Justice Department on them. And they received the same threats that I have received for years. **Let’s be clear, this is what wannabe dictators do.** Dehumanize their opponents, try to intimidate them, and try to discourage other elected officials from having the courage to speak out. I say the hell with that. As Franklin Roosevelt once said, there are times when you can judge a person by the enemies they have made. And while I would much rather be known for my friends, by FDR’s standard I’m doing pretty damn well. **Donald Trump holds our Constitution and voters in contempt, and I’m going to continue doing everything I can to hold him accountable.** The path to stopping him isn’t about winning an argument; it’s about putting a check on him that he cannot fire and cannot intimidate — a Democratic Senate majority with the gavels and the subpoena power to hold him to answer. **[Please, chip in today to help us win the seats that decide the majority in November:](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=14&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072626_WHcorrespondents&akid=10017%2E5257348%2EMKCblm)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [DONATE $10→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/7929?t=15&amount=10&refcode=aschiff_email_072626_WHcorrespondents&akid=10017%2E5257348%2EMKCblm)

# My Project 2027
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

[](https://us.list-manage.com/eZ9FpTcFFeq?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)

I’ve had one consistent message since I began my campaign: I think the US Congress is a good idea, and it would be nice if we had one.
We don’t have one right now. Instead, we have a bunch of lackeys who think it’s their job to trail along behind Donald Trump giving him whatever he wants—often, in the case of our Fifth District incumbent John McGuire, when Trump [hasn’t even asked](https://us.list-manage.com/ms8sb8PSV7_?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) for Congress’s approval and doesn’t think he needs it. (See McGuire’s [bill to limit birthright citizenship](https://us.list-manage.com/AKB96WprZ2E?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), an attempt to overturn a Supreme Court ruling by statute—which is _not_ a thing you can do.)
If we want Congress to serve as a check on the president and not a rubber stamp, then as I’ve [pointed out](https://us.list-manage.com/QgcASQePpGi?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a), we can’t wait for a “Project 2029.” We need to prepare for an epic showdown beginning just months from now, in January 2027. We need a Democrat in Congress who has the will to assert congressional power—and more than that, someone with a _plan_ to do it.
This is what I’ve just laid out. See my [recent article in _Liberal Currents_](https://us.list-manage.com/912Zymsmxw4?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) on my plan for a “Project 2027.” This is not a fantasy for what we would do if we have a supermajority and the ability to amend the Constitution. This is a plan for the situation we are likely to face next January.
“Our agenda should be based on what we can do with a simple majority—and with Trump still in the White House—which is the most likely outcome of the coming election. What can we do, with just the power of a congressional majority, to rein in Trump and reform the system?”
I’ll just give the main bullet points here:
**Declare a national emergency of national emergencies.**
“We should pass a law immediately suspending _all_ emergency executive powers, requiring the president to submit such powers for review by Congress, one at a time, if he wants any of them reinstated by ordinary law.
**Take away executive discretion.**
“Congress seems to only fitfully remember that it can just _tell the executive what to do_.”
**Rediscover the power and purpose of impeachment.**
“The public won’t believe that what Trump is doing is unprecedented or an emergency or an attack on the foundations of the American system if we don’t _act_ like it is. Impeachment is our way of saying that we really mean it, that these actions are beyond the bounds of legitimate power.”
**Use the power of the purse.**
“The power of the purse is the big stick the Constitution gave us to keep the president in line.... We should make it clear that we can make the gears of the executive grind to a halt until the president makes real concessions. This is the leverage we can use to get everything else.”
[Read the whole thing.](https://us.list-manage.com/S7G1Kx9rB8f?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a)
This is the big opportunity that we can salvage from the current danger to our democracy and the American system. We have an chance to build back the authority that Congress has foolishly allowed to bleed away for many decades.

If you want to help renew America’s confidence in our founding principles, support my campaign.
This is really your **last chance** to help me out before the primary on August 4, which is a week from Tuesday. Any money I’m going to spend to get over the top in the primary, I need to be spending in the next week, so please donate **now**.

| |

### What If We Don’t Have a Plan?

I’ll be putting out a lot of more videos and articles in the final week and a half of the primary, and the point of some of them is to differentiate myself from my opponents. (For my guide to all the Fifth District candidates, of both parties, see [here](https://us.list-manage.com/1BzvApOYCII?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a).) Most of all, I’m trying to differentiate myself from Tom Perriello, who is Mr. Establishment among the Democrats in Charlottesville—a known and familiar face who has been a fixture of this district’s politics for years.
I get that he seems like a safe and comfortable choice. But I had an opportunity recently to point out what worries me. What if, in contrast to what I propose above—what if we don’t have a plan?
I raised this recently in [my response](https://us.list-manage.com/15NzTA46xFb?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) to comments by Senator Mark Warner—who helped recruit and has endorse Perriello—in which he rules out the idea of a third impeachment of Donald Trump, as if Trump has somehow slowed down in his violations of the Constitution. But why ask voters to send us to Congress, if we don’t intend to use all the tools the Constitution gives us?
See also [my warning](https://us.list-manage.com/QI7lhVp05_u?e=bd44204496&c2id=2337f871c9bdb2dd73757dd8d1ee923a) about politicians who promise to ban data centers—the latest bandwagon everyone is jumping on because the polls have flipped against Big Tech and ambitious politicians see an opportunity for grandstanding. Thirty years of covering politics have given me a sharp-edge perspective on this, and I point out that when a politician panders like this, he’s not really telling you what he thinks about data centers. He’s just telling you that he really, really wants to be in office, and he’ll tell you whatever he thinks you want to hear. This is not a good reason to vote for someone—because the moment he’s afraid the political winds are shifting, he’ll sell you out.
If you want a Democratic candidate who is running, not because he wants to feel important, but because he has a cause—if you want a candidate who actually has a _plan_ for how we put Congress back on track, then I’m your man.

The President knows South Carolina needs a fighter who will finish what my brother started, and he's counting on us to deliver.

Fellow Patriot,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=07d78493ebbe4c06be8e3638e82b30e6&_e=ZfQxYlAFTdSxPDnCTJukO2nmNmRoz6LIjtJpgcyIpbnufUhAd5BzceOQKfE2YZX8CwRuk3UlHSJhhpPab1HSx58WYK-T1mtuFogMG3pRJI6PGh4yfYmUTGVKGKMjUMb5o75H0t16pciBMCmwtZ-7lmNUJNuJ7Sml7Kt6aINwDswF50yCkPcI_869qIDSGFi_63foGWZsD4S8p025maN2RDU2UB0tZrBeuzM_wLfttC45jHNH1ZoRjayzJGnXu7x_UeTR6L0R7W3k34xUwEMLNDRzIYn5sLgOiuBND_6epCJxtrUAzt0eHohCTcPGFWSTwVTJj7HpeMTyd7gzjDupJQVYmfUTEPKt6CbhuZMHZVDPsV92ScxHQ-GIGFu81TCizCQCskDEqzTNQkUHG2S1rNaGuh8lY0ERJbcjIY1TLcfLZmuImA9ppJpeSb1B-mvY3ONy5ccQVvD2nYRz0VyXdWTweUI6UTdgHFeeVo3w4wX_5jGyLQuldlvzeTHvr2Yg-hXfBLGHg6Xdpm8QwYNi3S7i4jFLyxZB72Lp44YKnvVhkyf4ODrkTVz4VO07dwQG__-I0MESk7u_YKg23AnAIyKaDrWDVkhL7F_B-_wEmuaQV9FtSvFW20CMlcVjOYxIAnlVHGt_xCl1RCgHIrv-vpnBt2jU0BzStUPNuhOUilI9N3QUDUTmO1_en2O2hSZkGJUFyw-zhHjXMBZi7Tpb_5FMehN4x9_dnRQRMNIGCfc%3D)**

I'll be straight with you - __I am behind financially.__ My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics.

**[Please help me raise the critical resources we need to win this Special Election Primary.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=07d78493ebbe4c06be8e3638e82b30e6&_e=ZfQxYlAFTdSxPDnCTJukO2nmNmRoz6LIjtJpgcyIpbnufUhAd5BzceOQKfE2YZX8CwRuk3UlHSJhhpPab1HSx58WYK-T1mtuFogMG3pRJI6PGh4yfYmUTGVKGKMjUMb5o75H0t16pciBMCmwtZ-7lmNUJNuJ7Sml7Kt6aINwDswF50yCkPcI_869qIDSGFi_63foGWZsD4S8p025maN2RDU2UB0tZrBeuzM_wLfttC45jHNH1ZoRjayzJGnXu7x_fqfwPQ5EiMR8vYpezFZicv_AuPH7S6vXOtjWaYivSPakN_pt8wrqUcBu5EYqH1WFx4m7qIeKOaYlbQwwicLWJUw9BXpLNNVsFSmJQrnScBaukAFJQfi_TFeYfwF49KPbqToWK5sVhb3PH1sEa22c5yZvdGVYC1gF2hsNp4Tf-fWtyOo-DyVV79t6MkugEZXph7w5ASE3b-_WUeCjDoMvHd4fDHHixJ7m8RWGi7jW5Bst4lb_nJv9EZoPzn84LF7qTnOZ2gRjGIlW3D21ZdMTrscxJAOYgS9ExH6bXlIBVOcfr5UYgLIkyG1WMSp01Y2ERN2WQjM18HEDMJ1N5mFf2CI-ftx1NKSW1-De_fBV9fvFlxrtI37OaK022XoybhTHnqNunaSWDqt2nlXCu1HzZrKxnO3B2R5SB5uuMulzXN8xqxuoLtxf3thWivlWyjP2zun5QgCap6b9qtu0p5PURkkMUUAN4Qpw5DdOZGCz_dU%3D)**

clean_body: I'm ready for the fight ahead, and I'm all in to run for the United States Senate. | Fellow Patriot, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult few weeks. I never thought I'd be in this position, but I am ready to answer the call from President Trump. I am ready to run. | | Paid for by Darline for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? Peter,
One of the biggest issues in our country is simple: working families are getting left behind. The only way we change that is by electing leaders who actually understand what everyday people go through.
I’m a working mom who shops on a budget and clips coupons. When I served in Congress, I brought that perspective to the table. **Every vote, debate, and hearing needs people asking, “How does this make life easier for working people?”**

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: Raja Krishnamoorthi is a fighter.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
Hi, it’s Nancy Pelosi.
I've spent my career fighting For The People — and building the Democratic power it takes to win those fights. Today, I’m asking for your help.
I've seen leaders come and go. I've watched some rise to the moment and others shrink from it. And after all these years, I can tell you that I know a fighter when I see one.
Raja Krishnamoorthi is a fighter.
As Speaker of the House, I appointed Raja, my dear friend and extraordinary colleague, to the Intelligence Committee, where he helped to keep our country safe and helped lead the impeachment of Donald Trump. I also appointed Raja to the Special Select Oversight Subcommittee responsible for taking on price-gouging pharmaceutical companies, investigating COVID scams and lowering healthcare costs. I worked with Raja for a decade in standing up to Big Tobacco, the gun lobby and many others who prioritize profit over our children’s health and safety.
And I watched Raja face down hatred and bigotry that would have broken a lesser person — and come back stronger every single time.
So when Raja told me he was launching Equal Opportunity Now — a new group dedicated to finding and supporting the next generation of Democratic leaders and priorities — I didn't hesitate. This is exactly what this moment demands.
Because let me be clear about what we are facing:
Donald Trump and his MAGA extremists are a danger to our Constitution, our children and our Democracy. Full stop.
They are actively working to dismantle the institutions that are the foundation of our government of, by and For The People. They are stripping away the safety net that millions of working families depend on to give massive tax breaks to their ultra rich MAGA donors on the backs of vulnerable Americans. And they are counting on us to be too tired, too divided or too discouraged to stop them.
They don't know us very well, do they? We don’t agonize — we organize!
I have spent decades building the Democratic infrastructure it takes to win — to take back the House, to protect our majorities and to deliver For the People. That is the ongoing work of my PAC to the Future. And Raja is building the bench of bold, battle-tested leaders who will carry this fight forward for decades to come with Equal Opportunity Now.
Today, I’m asking you to support Raja’s Equal Opportunity Now and my PAC to the Future. We need both as we build an America that honors the vision of our Founders, the service and sacrifice of our men and women in uniform and the dreams and aspirations of our children.
Will you split a donation of $25 or $50 between PAC to the Future and Equal Opportunity Now right now? Your support will do directly to winning the fights ahead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
SPLIT A DONATION NOW! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-pac2thefuture]
I could not be more proud of Raja’s leadership and of continuing to fight alongside him for our shared values and for our Democracy. Let's get to work!
NANCY

name: Dr. Trent Talbot
subject: How We Save Our Children
body:
| | | |
---
Counter the forces pushing our kids toward isolation.
---
| | Dear friend, How do we fight childhood isolation in a world where values and community are increasingly slipping away? Not so long ago, community stood at the very center of everyday life. Kids played together in the streets until the sun went down. Neighbors knew one another by name and shared each other's joys and burdens.And on Sunday, families gathered at church.Faith. Family. Community. These were once the centers of daily life. But as we've all observed, the world today looks very different. When you look around now, the communities we once cherished seem strangely quiet. That’s why BRAVE FOR GOOD is coming together to once more fill our libraries with books that put God first, community first, America first – restoring values that shaped generations before us. **[But we need YOU to make this possible.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=dce35ace82c444f19dd0ffbe76f4375f&_e=WWPM95FHfI0eCc8cMTieE5Vu1BengRDcdcMg0vAS9BrGBpp92btNvcpsikuxxSL07M6KL_QydSKV6sLSlcDR1y_qByGYuQ6UydeoxC48mqhgeh_Ei453dtGCsDaLBj6xUjtWaEUO40Xh6-wAmmgHPJzEf6VSC10wZJwDojg-8FQNdLJm45-6Z9Imfc_npRMFhW-1msBvVh7nasxnJqaK6gLT-eSC8ZcAGm9RGxkx1_IwFuSupD55GQeA0Ni6PmOQ3i6Moje8jtTe1EIrvw8MfSyZpu5OS167niZ__GuzZt844PyCAr-oZVt42yVSr48Bibh67ENMOm39dmFaibTA4vp60Er1Q5Iy0W56Sn1o5gzOS8NOtuEAQIscARzVtSys1e1A-RxtykoSoOy6CVR_gmOZ_U4jXEaSOun0trV7y32QlZzyPuF5cNOZumRWQOT_Dxh9IUAue2-QjD4V_5wpsA%3D%3D)** These timeless principles once shaped children from a young age, giving them purpose, character, and a sense of belonging. Without them today, too many children grow up disconnected—and alone. My name is Trent Talbot and when I had my children, I knew I could no longer allow teachers, celebrities, and social media influencers to teach my kids to hate America or the ideals that made it great. This is why I founded BRAVE FOR GOOD with the simple mission: to raise my children to love and cherish God, family, community, and country — the very values the Left is working hardest to silence. At BRAVE FOR GOOD we are doing everything in our power to counter the Left’s lies with THE TRUTH. We are doing this through promoting and donating books like:

As we counter a generation struggling with rising loneliness and despair, what is most critical is to help children turn away from isolation and rediscover truth, purpose, and belonging. But we need your help. **[Will you join us in bringing our children back to the sources of happiness?](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=dce35ace82c444f19dd0ffbe76f4375f&_e=WWPM95FHfI0eCc8cMTieE5Vu1BengRDcdcMg0vAS9BrGBpp92btNvcpsikuxxSL07M6KL_QydSKV6sLSlcDR1y_qByGYuQ6UydeoxC48mqhgeh_Ei453dtGCsDaLBj6xg98wktelu0vfaEIoWnhRGqmBRmgpGD4NiqgrnckqVneThG4qRay96MjyCJEinoQU1mmK4n4fimYJwLXyhqsXbeI1x0Z42GbleO967TugDlQKtZSjZYKwLCK1UGnG_THaQdoqRmqfrZfX4FbmYkANkVmaMdrSON84UjQ6WJMu9E0oO7nJ9FYpjeKvG_jPOyNGyO8yqgcKzjjodRhOp3Pcf8PX0vKSBl7JZnGSvr2gnKRmvLnr-Z_0DAYyp3jXLfWhDIBr_TtVOJ2uMnebmOZ0HOEwl4ecoyg3ileXSutxJNrw6duZrfOKlvw_MYXsL5tlXF8PxpjwrLNi0XBPd2RTuw%3D%3D)** One way BRAVE FOR GOOD is restoring communities is through the expansion of “See You at the Library” movement. For America’s 250th birthday, our goal is to reach over 250,000 children in the next year. To achieve this we need you. **[With a tax-deductible gift of $125, YOU will sponsor one complete Story Hour Kit for a local library.](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=dce35ace82c444f19dd0ffbe76f4375f&_e=WWPM95FHfI0eCc8cMTieE5Vu1BengRDcdcMg0vAS9BrGBpp92btNvcpsikuxxSL07M6KL_QydSKV6sLSlcDR1y_qByGYuQ6UydeoxC48mqhgeh_Ei453dtGCsDaLBj6x4bMkT9KF4vZEznvsMCjmJh7E-L_w8AHP4l1pSYe9selHeXJvxiEgbSneUxalqM1yWhSL2UmMPA22yCtH6OrZ_q7QEwgPprKb9ye-HSaGeECdFteHKZG00KAIalZVZO10-UyjZUST1LFYRCclTFMwTWwfFxVQqE5q2carLmXD11bnzCZoyvwc66zSe0yCIl5_IHkc4tj0FO3UY9F-mqyY-pjgKq1DBG5HCWCG24hUAPJw53EIxQNaAKTSEySbkPJPL-5ta3z2JQFMqJdKlU8BzOcXqllgpmGnmbUJoA73N7OP0UA4XqWFDnlp2eHyjdfhMvw3T4_cGWxItz3DIxtLGQ%3D%3D)**
---
Singlehandedly, it is your gift that reaches 50 children with this wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Even more importantly, your sponsorship helps bring communities together again – countering the forces pushes our children toward isolation. Every book placed into a child’s hands is a small but powerful step toward rebuilding the communities we need to keep our country strong. Together, we can ensure the next generation is not defined by loneliness and despair, but inspired by faith, courage, and love of their country. Thank you for standing with our children.

# [Gov. Gretchen Whitmer: I'm proud to say that Haley Stevens has my endorsement for U.S. Senate.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=208367766&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MzY3NzY2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUwOTk3MzMsImV4cCI6MTc4NzY5MTczMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.cU5_oxTgf2eiXUnDpw2ZDgHFgt9RZbV00Xi2CAm0sW0)
### Here's why I'm jumping into this race - and why you should too:
Jul 26
---

---
| | | [](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/gov-gretchen-whitmer-im-proud-to?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-restack-comment&action=restack-comment&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjA4MzY3NzY2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODUwOTk3MzMsImV4cCI6MTc4NzY5MTczMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.cU5_oxTgf2eiXUnDpw2ZDgHFgt9RZbV00Xi2CAm0sW0&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/gov-gretchen-whitmer-im-proud-to?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends, it's Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
I want you to hear this from me personally: **I 'm endorsing Haley Stevens to be our next U.S. senator from Michigan - and I'm proud to do it.**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0ba1dad3-532f-4806-91a8-b7640a63a257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Haley is a shining example of what Michiganders can be at our best. She brings grit, determination, and courage to everything she does, and she does it with a care for her neighbors and community that our country needs more of.
Throughout her time in the Obama administration, she helped save over 200,000 auto industry jobs. She was something special back in those days, and since then, her years serving in Congress representing Michigan's 11th district have only made me more confident in her abilities as a leader.
She's the kind of fighter we need in the Senate. And there's not a doubt in my mind that she's got what it takes to defeat Trump's handpicked candidate, Mike Rogers, in the general election.
Don't take my word for it, though, folks. The polls, pundits, and even Mike Rogers himself have all been saying it: Haley Stevens is the strongest candidate to keep Michigan blue and deliver a Democratic Senate majority in November.
That's why the GOP is throwing everything they've got at defeating her. They're scared to face her in the general election - _and they should be_.
**But with 9 days until polls close, Haley needs our help right now. Mine** _**and**_**yours, friend.**
This is a race that will likely determine Senate control - and with it, the shape of the remainder of Trump's presidency.
If we lose in Michigan, Democrats will lose our best shot at flipping the Senate and putting a much-needed check on the MAGA agenda. I'm not ready to let that happen, and I know you feel the same.
**[There 's simply too much at stake for any one of us to stay on the sidelines right now. That's why I'm personally asking you to join me in throwing your support behind Haley's campaign. Will you make a donation of $30 or more today to help ensure Haley's team has the resources to win this primary so we can keep Michigan blue?](https://substack.com/redirect/8c81be55-b788-4c96-bb47-5521636c2f4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/8c81be55-b788-4c96-bb47-5521636c2f4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Together, we can deliver a Democratic Senate majority in November.
Thank you for standing with me in this critical moment,
Gov. Gretchen Whitmer

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/8c81be55-b788-4c96-bb47-5521636c2f4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

How did Americans across the country, especially in the South, respond to the Supreme Court's decision to legally codify racial gerrymandering? They turned out in droves to march for their fundamental right to vote, folks.
For those of us who couldn't make it to Selma, Montgomery, or other places to march? We have to do everything we can to register a tidal wave of voters across the country.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Every $3 chipped in can help us register a new voter. If you're with us in this fight, please pitch in $30 or whatever you can today to help register 10 new voters >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=072626_2&amount=30]

If anti-voting forces are going to stack the deck against the communities we serve, then we will work even harder to engage and rally these voters, lift their voices, and defend their right to vote.
Despite vote-suppressing courts and state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter participation has been increasing. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
This voter registration work, at just about $3 per new voter, is how we can make the greatest impact. | Peter,
All hell has broken loose in Louisiana. Starting on April 28th, 2026, MAGA began an all out assault on Louisiana's democratic system, a coup, which to this day has still not relented.
Following the Supreme Court decision to gut the Voting Rights Act, they cancelled our elections, threw out over 42,000 ballots, and introduced a segregated Jim Crow era map that erases one of our Black majority districts.
We face nothing short of the permanent extinction of Democratic power here in Louisiana and we are outmanned and outgunned.
However, despite the steep odds we face, Democrats from across the nation have stepped up. Over 64,000 individual donors contributed a combined $1.7 million dollars to our party helping fuel an unprecedented Democratic victory in our May 16th elections, the first election since the SCOTUS ruling against the VRA.
And now key leaders like Gavin Newsom, US Senator Cory Booker, and former Vice President Kamala Harris who just announced she will head to New Orleans, are wading in to join our fight against the disenfranchisement of over 1.5 million Black voters:

The battle lines are being drawn in real time. Powerful forces are amassing on both sides. Republicans are scared because they know Democrats can win in their own backyard.
To do our part in 2026 Louisiana Democrats have this gargantuan task in front of us:

* Defend incumbent Congressman Cleo Fields and Congressman Troy Carter from MAGA attempts to unseat them. MAGA has already come for Congressman Cleo Fields' district but Carter's district may now be next on the redistricting chopping block.

* Flip Louisiana's red US Senate Seat and elect Louisiana's first Black US Senator, Democrat Jamie Davis.

* Compete in all four of Louisiana's 4 red Congressional districts -- for the first time in many years Louisiana Dems have a candidate vying for each seat.

Democrats performed so well on May 16th, so many women and Black voters showed up, and MAGA's 5 constitutional amendments were rejected so mightily, that James Carville said Democrats have a "fighting chance" to flip the US Senate seat in Louisiana this year.
There was never supposed to be a fight of this magnitude in Louisiana and MAGA is panicking. If they lose the Deep South, there is no coming back from this.

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

| | | | | |
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. clean_body: Not what I spent my time doing | | | | | | Peter, I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most. I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf. And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals. That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days. But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. body:
We have 100 days to build a different kind of campaign and I’m asking 100 people to give $100.

| | |

---
---
---
Peter, **Today marks 100 days until Election Day**. That means we have 100 days to make a real change in Augusta. For too long, Republicans and Democrats have turned fighting and finger-pointing into a political sport instead of working together to get results for the people of Maine. Meanwhile, you are paying the price with higher energy bills, housing costs that are out of reach, taxes that keep climbing, and child care that too many families simply can’t afford. Mainers cannot afford more of the same. I’m running as an **Independent** because I believe the Governor should answer to the people of Maine not party bosses, insiders, or special interests. As Governor, I will fight to lower the cost of living in our state:
* lower energy costs
* make housing attainable
* bring real accountability to taxes and spending

Maine should be a place where you can afford to live, work, raise a family, and build a future in the state you love. That’s why today I’m asking:

subject: The Pentagon deleted four dead soldiers overnight to protect Trump.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elect Evan Hunt
body:
A soldier is not a rounding error. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYE5U9NTRbOMLNsSMiwuHsSkvWspXpNzcqkzSIoupdDWkL2pjwIimGUsMZ1ZguqiawQwc8Iht3aCrkdXpsjBpSLw1ZyD5bxKE_JcgYrCqbqG7_tehhOh1WEwcx0WWEaqqbz2IrUEQfh83RveGzwERUNP1fHG6jXeM-lCtU0TMjLzcPT3ebtGl0x9K8At4hTDupF4MxplK3Bg8lbK008n2eggLB-LqM4Vom7mpG3IyIBR0VOJmrmJoiaQByqA3GzjoZqsVMQWFIiNkqlf2XdN1U7rHZEvVdFO3mbd_VW63eP97jFC9-aN9T5tLHarvepys1QAqCBuGIgA1Niss5cgI0ptYcdrL4zMufxshke66Cwz/4sn/XBxTUWszRZKCxkn06MTccg/h0/h001.SvOWy59TxP3H1AhD-5lVgL_GS6gEbSZPbAbmHiEZsa4)
---
Peter, Last Wednesday, the Pentagon's website said 18 Americans had been killed in this illegal war with Iran. **By Thursday morning, that number had changed to 14.** Those four soldiers were still gone on Thursday. Three had been killed in Jordan and one in northern Iraq. Nothing about that changed. This administration just scrubbed their names from the count because they died after Trump declared a ceasefire that never held.
---
[ **Honor the fallen. Flip TX-03.** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt82MGS5blNSvWwA9-MV4iahJt3lEhC4iKw7r32UECCNv2p2sWJycKt7j2SkBtu5DlMTvGXmrrz183PTFP7-Yba-hA6nEWQeX-f-cjXjhZVCSrCWbKEZtSyo1PM1HLsgCqXdZJEMJbkG0mdeTMsTv1hrlt7pl9QQHUP60OjpDUxoEY5cRdOf3u_ZHaaj1Z2X6zhlIz8vEY15e3Bv9sfIOJDKx7KL8VlxSjx9QU7qr6HzZpS_Ob7uBQWecaAqazWS3wzO8IU0A5BHYU53atY4uQEfCDEOXBkeBwUcTeutLVXwG-eDchBlAuDUpKgUxmHCqWWMWL0uCtlAcKqocBbR2NAo5BKxHjjZb15P58I8euDovTkTTG1JKbBFkaUPeK55H2Z4A3o556JWZj1NjGhoxYIYk/4sn/XBxTUWszRZKCxkn06MTccg/h1/h001.Iz53uLzU5hTk4sL45jSZTMXcDL0f1wofuYUtu57fGq8)
---
One of the names shamefully erased was Pvt. Isabella Gonzalez, a 19-year-old from Carrollton, TX — right next door.
She was barely older than my own daughter, and about the same age as I was when I joined the Air Force. She had a full life and bright career ahead of her.
Instead, Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump treated her like a rounding error.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt82MGS5blNSvWwA9-MV4iahJt3lEhC4iKw7r32UECCNv2gYBsQVzvV2-_-0b0HZ4gnPPBEepXEwpkIC9yNpdKtz45_myhCsh-g86OWGM_W4NBzrn0WXtXK8Xcfao3AYn71CtmO4hVNhuum18RyH7-ZiKHnNbHFG925QqC3-FkzazMGufS8_m5qe7Z2LgD5_4voWjpzJiwBpxMFXMWsUR7tEwlXa58MeJQk9bXdGDKpaCRt61bq5Bq4PVr77ZQcT9AL2ilofn8vv64IzTMttbiEd22-mnVTw2Ecg5XorS03BhJgRFBI6xd-RWcoNggcaXs3A92IKnC9rdcr2j-W-Pwsw7kkUZyxK4GV3zl-ND7W7WY9mI6Rddp_lQEIR7ZGQohZvhsc9XPaDncdn5Xf2KzEaA/4sn/XBxTUWszRZKCxkn06MTccg/h2/h001.VgSV4uBWwiulp3mNHC2KLFDcIQXQjcq1m4fKy5I43fQ)
---
I flew combat missions over Afghanistan, and I have grieved brothers and sisters in arms who did not make it home.
Every single one of those numbers is a person.
A son, a daughter, somebody's whole world.
To reach into that list and delete four of them to protect a politician's win column is one of the most shameful things I have ever watched my government do.
[Help us send someone to Congress who will never let a soldier's sacrifice be treated like a rounding error.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt82MGS5blNSvWwA9-MV4iahJt3lEhC4iKw7r32UECCNv2vIRK41dqzVkstz8fVUT0aAvUDJltCgB3Rf69jBjlAukzkpXORgCTg0ylMTrlMIMwzoJ85qQTjzlN79PQKEm4OhxLigxklFwoaKQDTI5DrqwQvkDgXThQfU5W1foQqME3OEki-nuQV6TXe-_-tD9IRND6VUEMQBsmfcZZJS9Ze9bGchqhnYQVZOetjUcCK8wrGreNsZTqYYoWvNh4aaDv2IcRgFfbXXSl7ffBkixgwVU66DHeIYmIS1yszT8z0Bp1m4sh8Aw1IPmm0TswB8bFDekJTONxAG8T0OJzLZa4XuBeGMGwVYEd6ZrVmIfSvz1mLt7PVEQz-45HlI-nVDfT0uOqvwX4xC7CquG4v9N2zKA/4sn/XBxTUWszRZKCxkn06MTccg/h3/h001.FZQ16Mk0mamFJw71Kz2G-l5vuBOX-H7mJg44hKMQVJw)
This brand of betrayal and bureaucratic cowardice has defined this administration and its unfailing allies like Keith Self from the start.
They gutted the VA and left veterans waiting months for care, while making them perform in cheap vanity parades for the President’s birthday.
They marched us into an illegal war with no strategy and no way out.
They buried the news that Iranian strikes wounded dozens of our troops in Jordan and went months without telling the public anything.
Now they are doctoring the body count itself.
Every time you think these incompetent people have found the floor, they pull up the boards and keep digging.
And Keith Self, a man who wore the uniform and led men in combat, is right in the thick of it.
He knows what those four names cost.
He says nothing anyway, because Donald Trump's feelings matter more to him than the honor of the dead.
There is no uglier betrayal a veteran in power can commit.
Pvt. Gonzalez deserves better. All four of those families deserve a country with the decency to admit how their loved ones died.
[Help us flip this seat and be the ones who finally give it to them.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt82MGS5blNSvWwA9-MV4iahJt3lEhC4iKw7r32UECCNv2w5zHWKgyt4bZt3ScM9upXaqxDMGBjAkOGT160g9Fr7s6IIhcsoKBP2-UR44M4cnLN2SY3uKepKCEE6h797VlrbcwCZYxGEOtuW76I8nNQLqr57a3VRgzACjioXPCGEx38HGLHW-Py4Xt5Qw5jtdAk5Efs7jbEhmAKbDlq2P384VpBW48c4V2dPw597NBlRBNL8dLoSclA154Bt0C-NHWnmGo63A5XDA8YG0l2-EUJm9kMZkGYidJqpHN-rEjT9RR-d4YzrsvJkPkkkeZboW7z9iNSpsaW3JRAbpqTKoMubVAlGDUrCMydqmQtKkH1YeiYW5CQDItFoFoyUoa-D17VOA-ADHdRTDPRkgzRaFOQuk/4sn/XBxTUWszRZKCxkn06MTccg/h4/h001.txOeofXS7E6-ZjbbjRDOlEjJrfmytY0XikbiFvxuIxE)

clean_body: A soldier is not a rounding error. | | Peter, Last Wednesday, the Pentagon's website said 18 Americans had been killed in this illegal war with Iran. By Thursday morning, that number had changed to 14. Those four soldiers were still gone on Thursday. Three had been killed in Jordan and one in northern Iraq. Nothing about that changed. This administration just scrubbed their names from the count because they died after Trump declared a ceasefire that never held. One of the names shamefully erased was Pvt. Isabella Gonzalez, a 19-year-old from Carrollton, TX — right next door. She was barely older than my own daughter, and about the same age as I was when I joined the Air Force. She had a full life and bright career ahead of her. Instead, Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump treated her like a rounding error. | I flew combat missions over Afghanistan, and I have grieved brothers and sisters in arms who did not make it home. Every single one of those numbers is a person. A son, a daughter, somebody's whole world. To reach into that list and delete four of them to protect a politician's win column is one of the most shameful things I have ever watched my government do. This brand of betrayal and bureaucratic cowardice has defined this administration and its unfailing allies like Keith Self from the start. They gutted the VA and left veterans waiting months for care, while making them perform in cheap vanity parades for the President’s birthday. They marched us into an illegal war with no strategy and no way out. They buried the news that Iranian strikes wounded dozens of our troops in Jordan and went months without telling the public anything. Now they are doctoring the body count itself. Every time you think these incompetent people have found the floor, they pull up the boards and keep digging. And Keith Self, a man who wore the uniform and led men in combat, is right in the thick of it. He knows what those four names cost. He says nothing anyway, because Donald Trump's feelings matter more to him than the honor of the dead. There is no uglier betrayal a veteran in power can commit. Pvt. Gonzalez deserves better. All four of those families deserve a country with the decency to admit how their loved ones died. Brandon Gill and at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. You could say I prefer the simple things in life. I grew up on a cattle ranch and television isn’t my pastime. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They are the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I’ve committed my life & career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. The left hates you, they hate your vote, and they hate MAGA for putting America First. Peter, today, I’ll make the same promise to you that I’ve made to myself, to my wife, and to my children. As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Believe me, I’m not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Texting you like this is the last thing I thought I’d have to do. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction & God has put it on my heart to fight with all that I have. This is more than a polite request. This is now a final plea for your support. Sincerely, Congressman Brandon Gill(R) TX-26 | | | Paid for by Brandon Gill for Texas | | PO BOX 827 Arlington, VA 22216 Click here to_

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. clean_body: Today’s milestone | | | Believe it or not, the November elections are exactly 100 days away. And here in Georgia, early voting starts in just 79 days. That means we only have 100 days to: Generate historic Black turnout in Georgia and across the South — showing that voters are ready to stand up against new racist voting maps. Prevent or mitigate sweeping attempts at voter suppression. Get out the vote for Democracy Champions in hotly contested races — which will decide whether voting rights champions help manage elections for years to come, and can help decide who has access to the ballot box for the long run. = Here’s one big, exciting area of opportunity for the November elections: Democrats lead the generic ballot for the Georgia House by 8 points, putting control of the chamber “in play for the first time in recent memory” according to State Navigate.** We only need to flip 10 seats — one less than Democrats flipped in 2018, the last time there was a midterm election while Donald Trump was an unpopular president. But it’s going to take 100 days of concentrated outreach, voter protection, and mobilization to win these races, where just a few dozen voters could swing the outcome. # [](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1317?t=1&akid=939%2E3892029%2E-yj8UA)

☀️ Peter — to anyone who cares about holding Donald Trump accountable, please don’t click away from this message. It’ll only take a minute. 🌴
Today is Sunday, July 26, and Alex Vindman is humbly asking for your support to flip Florida’s Senate seat blue before his July FEC deadline in 3 days.

It wasn’t long ago when a Democrat represented Florida in the Senate. As a former combat veteran and national security expert who has stood up to Trump, Alex has the background to win back voters, win this Senate race, and pull Florida back to a battleground state.

But running a Senate campaign in Florida is expensive — and National Republicans are already trying to pummel Alex with attack ads.
While Ashley Moody relies on special interests to fund her campaign, Alex is counting on you to help overcome their attacks and win this race.

If everyone reading this email chipped in $3, we would have the resources to build the largest grassroots movement in Florida history.
But unfortunately, not everyone gives. That’s why we’re counting on everyone who knows the stakes of this election, and the importance of defending our democracy, to pitch in now.

Peter the ADA was a **massive** victory for the disabled community. 36 years ago today, July 26 1990, the Americans with Disabilities act was signed into law. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: The President of the United States of America thinks he’s a king.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2582%2E5691347%2Eb7i_b9)

Are you trying to tune it all out?
The chaos. The corruption. The cruelty.
Or maybe, in some weird way, is it starting to feel normal?
The headlines blur. The shock wears off.
Authoritarianism doesn’t always march in under martial law.
It creeps in. Through erosion. Through silence. Through resignation. Through the quiet, incremental loss of just enough ground that, over time, our reality starts to feel unfamiliar, and the things we took for granted begin to disappear.
That’s why I’m asking you: Don’t look away. Don’t get distracted. Because the next fight is here, and Georgia is the front line.
I’m the only Democratic Senator running for reelection in a state Donald Trump won in 2024. MAGA has made this campaign their #1 target in the midterms.
[**So if you’re alarmed by what’s happening in our country — and ready to fight back — I’m asking you to rush a contribution to my reelection campaign today.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260726-3-subs&utm_campaign=em260726-3-subs&t=2&akid=2582%2E5691347%2Eb7i_b9)
Here’s the link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-em-july26**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260726-3-subs&utm_campaign=em260726-3-subs&t=3&akid=2582%2E5691347%2Eb7i_b9)
Before I ran for Senate, I investigated corruption and human rights abuses abroad.
I know what authoritarianism looks like. I know this pattern.
Trump and his lieutenants are flaunting corruption, harassing opponents, repressing dissent, and trying to intimidate critics into silence.
The President of the United States of America thinks he’s a king.
Just in the last few months:
* He delivered a primetime sour grapes presidential address reheating his debunked conspiracy theory that he won the 2020 election.

* He tried to get Congress to give him massive taxpayer funding for the crooked ballroom.

* He said it’s not possible for us to take care of daycare, Medicaid, or Medicare but he’d need $200 billion to fund his war in Iran that no one voted for.

I ran for Senate in 2020 for two reasons: To root out the endemic corruption that enabled Trump’s rise, and to help Georgia and our nation flourish.
Right now, I’m doing everything I can in the Senate to confront this Administration’s lawless abuses.
But I’m also in the toughest and most consequential reelection fight of the midterms. MAGA is turning its focus to Georgia to lock in long-term control of the Senate for Trump.
Back when I launched my first Senate campaign, the pundits said flipping a seat in Georgia was impossible, that a millennial investigative journalist couldn’t win a race the GOP had locked down for two decades.
But together, we built one of the most powerful grassroots movements this country has ever seen, and delivered a historic victory that helped Democrats win Senate control.
_Now, we have to do it again._
My team is working day and night to rebuild that organizing machine. Our plan is to reach voters in every corner of the state like we did before.
We know how to win here. But we need your help to do it.
[**So please, pitch in a few dollars to support my reelection campaign before our end-of-month deadline. I’d be incredibly grateful for your support.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260726-3-subs&utm_campaign=em260726-3-subs&t=4&akid=2582%2E5691347%2Eb7i_b9)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-july26.m6nGhw&refcode=em260726-3-subs&utm_campaign=em260726-3-subs&t=5&akid=2582%2E5691347%2Eb7i_b9)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff
